levels.name: Silent clubstep
levels.author: TheRealSailent
levels.desc: One of the most legendary and recognizable levels in Geometry Dash. Formerly impossible and was initially hack-verified by Sailent in 1.8. Houses the "8 Jumps of Hell" and the infamous 6% ship part, among other classic sections.

levels.name: Ashley Wave Trials
levels.author: OddMod
levels.desc: A level with a pink/red color scheme that is entirely wave, as the name suggests. The level remained unrated until CBF was added to the game and the level was eventually rated a while later.

levels.name: Acheron
levels.author: ryamu
levels.desc: Iconic sequel to Tartarus. Intimidating 1.9 styled level that gradually gets less red and more black as it continues. Known for its impossibly tight wave sections & chokepoints.

levels.name: Tidal Wave
levels.author: OniLinkGD
levels.desc: A former Top 1 and Onilink's first rated level, featuring incredibly difficult wave sections spread over its 3 minute runtime. Unlike most other top 1s, this level takes a very different approach to its style, theming it around the ocean and the beach with its blue and yellow colour scheme.

levels.name: Avernus
levels.author: PockeWindfish
levels.desc: Well-known, poorly received, but unexpectedly enjoyable hell themed extreme which has gone through its fair share of controversy. Recognizable for its fixed hitboxes and ridiculous ship and wave sections.

levels.name: Nullscapes
levels.author: ItzKiba
levels.desc: The sequel to Shardscapes and the current hardest level to use one gamemode, that being robot. Expanding on its predecessor, it features more noticeable progression, an orb cycling gimmick and most importantly much more unforgiving gameplay. Includes a CBF blocker which has sparked a significant amo

levels.name: Spectre
levels.author: xander556
levels.desc: Zodiac sequel that was in the works for 4 years. Vaguely cool-toned with many parts by some of the most famous creators, like CuLuC, Darwin and Helpegasus.

levels.name: BOOBAWAMBA
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: The current hardest memory extreme, themed around a dark abandoned factory with limited visibility. Features a randomized ending where five details throughout the level determine whether or not to click their corresponding toggle triggers. Built over the course of two years and thousands of hours, A

levels.name: Anathema
levels.author: nikroplays
levels.desc: Legendary finale of the Dedication Series that took over 6 years to be finished and verified. Reminiscent of many different styles throughout 2.1.

levels.name: andromeda
levels.author: Insxne97
levels.desc: Relatively unknown considering its difficulty. Pink and purple space themed level with incredibly high-CPS gameplay and flashy visuals. Took over a year to be completed.

levels.name: Every End
levels.author: MindCap
levels.desc: The hardest endurance level in Geometry Dash, featuring over 7 minutes of simple yet brutal 1.0 cube timings. Its difficulty balancing and specific skillset have lead it to being very accessible for a top level. Despite its simple 1.0 aesthetic, its technically impressive background effect involved

levels.name: Quanteuse processing
levels.author: Renn241
levels.desc: An uncanny and extremely raw superbuffed remake of the main level Blast Processing, with gameplay by Renn241 and Blankb. Not meant to be a serious level.

levels.name: Thinking Space II
levels.author: CairoX
levels.desc: An official sequel to Thinking Space and former top 1. Unlike the original, its decoration is in a glow design style, but it's more similar in gameplay as it has several gameplay references to the original and is also extremely end carried. The first top 1 in many years that was not built intentiona

levels.name: Amethyst
levels.author: iMist
levels.desc: A former top 1, dethroning Tidal Wave after two years. It's inspired by The Golden, including a cave decoration with rocks, geodes, and purple and pink crystals. The gameplay consists of a lot of extremely hard waves and ship gameplay, similar to The Golden but with an extension and a random 240 fra

levels.name: Flamewall
levels.author: UNarwall
levels.desc: Almost seven minutes of extremely fast and challenging gameplay, using a similarly very fast and dramatic symphonic metal song, and featuring very few break sections for its length. Features a gargantuan roster of creators and took multiple years to come out, in part thanks to the verifier dying at

levels.name: Society
levels.author: Neomarbilan
levels.desc: The sequel to Escalator and a nerfed impossible level. Featuring a dreamcore/weirdcore aesthetic, it is filled with references and explores themes of mental instability.

levels.name: Subsuming Vortex
levels.author: CursedZ
levels.desc: Created all the way in 2018 by SeptaGon7 and redecorated by Renn241. The name is a reference to a Calamity Mod spell tome with the same name.

levels.name: ORBIT
levels.author: MindCap
levels.desc: One of Mindcap's most ambitious projects to date, filled with over 2 minutes of fast-paced timings, all of which are orb clicks. levels.name: Penumbral
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Currently the second-hardest CherryTeam level on the list, featuring an intense, flashy monochromatic palette and brutal ship and wave chokepoints. The first extreme demon to use xStep as its song.

levels.name: Ultra Paracosm
levels.author: declanlc
levels.desc: Superbuffed remake of Hyper Paracosm, created by declanlc and Renn241. Notably extremely first half heavy, with most of the difficulty concentrated in the first wave parts. Sadly not the easy demon

levels.name: KILLSTEALER
levels.author: Rynoxiouss
levels.desc: An old XXL+ mega-collab that began way back in 2020 and was finished and verified more than half a decade later. levels.name: Green Bullet
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Formerly known as “0 Bullet,” Created in collaboration with MiNaY & cherryteam as their hardest level yet. It showcases a neon-green structure throughout, and has fast-paced timings with excruciatingly tight gaps in-between. Its placement kicked Zodiac out of the top 150 after over 7 years.

levels.name: Antarctic Lights
levels.author: declanlc
levels.desc: The current hardest Nine Circles level in the game. Remake of Arctic Lights with improved decoration and a gigantic increase in difficulty, which is why it took almost 3 years to get verified.

levels.name: FOREST OF SPIKES
levels.author: Bimms
levels.desc: Tight and claustrophobic level set to a very intense Waterflame track. Themed around spikes, with nearly 50% of all objects in the level being a variant of spike. Very first-half carried, and contains an ending where you must identify and count flashing eyes and must click accordingly to avoid crash

levels.name: Artemis 13
levels.author: mvngo
levels.desc: A monochrome design level featuring many clubstep monsters scattered throughout. It was originally harder before being nerfed by Zoink following a controversy surrounding the original host. Features an extremely hard ship at 19%.

levels.name: GRIEF
levels.author: IcEDCave
levels.desc: One of the most anticipated top 1s in the game's history, with a verification process spanning 396 streams and a cumulative playtime of 922 hours; currently the hardest level in the game.

levels.name: Abyss of Darkness
levels.author: Exen
levels.desc: Iconic megacollab with an equally as iconic song. Originally was finished in 2018, but was redecorated in 2021. Known for its slow gameplay and very inconsistent decoration quality.

levels.name: Kyouki
levels.author: Demishio
levels.desc: Blue and purple glowy effect level and Demishio's 3rd extreme demon project. Memorably high quality gameplay and effects with an iconic Creo song.

levels.name: Maniacal Chains
levels.author: LordDivinity
levels.desc: Originally meant to be a showcased impossible level built several years ago by LordDivinity, and eventually taken on and verified by spcreat. Using the same song as Killbot, the aesthetic is extremely flashy and intense, with the second and final drop comprising a large part of the level's difficult

levels.name: KOCMOC
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Formerly CherryTeam's hardest level. Although the level is mostly flashy pink and purple, it takes heavy inspiration from Slaughterhouse and mostly consists of tight wave spam and straight-fly. Pronounced as "cosmos".

levels.name: Tunnel of Despair
levels.author: Exen
levels.desc: Timing based greyscale level with red as its secondary color. Decorated exclusively by ivyteal. Generally repetitive with poorly received gameplay. Verification also features Zoink admitting to "hacking" Eternal Moment.

levels.name: Deimos
levels.author: ItsHybrid
levels.desc: Extremely large megacollab and sequel to Phobos. Parts significantly vary in design and color similarly to Phobos, and the iconic final dual was kept nearly identical.

levels.name: The Lightning Rod
levels.author: Lavatrex
levels.desc: Distinct and incredibly creative extreme themed around traversing and escaping the inside of an electric tower/rod. Supposedly one of the learniest levels on the main-list with extremely high-cps and quirky gameplay.

levels.name: Eyes in the Water
levels.author: nothawkyre
levels.desc: Well known for its unique decoration, unique "eye" theme, and iconic song. Includes a very strange cast of creators, with Bli, ivyteal, and skywalker14 all participating. First ship is incredibly difficult.

levels.name: Menace
levels.author: ArraegenGD
levels.desc: White, orange and black effect level with plenty of lore and an entire poem within it. Includes some incredibly unorthodox gameplay. The level's song was also created by the creator, Arraegen, specifically for this project.

levels.name: Based After Based
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: Initially a top 10 made without spikes and entirely dual gameplay that avoids speed changes. The verifier somehow fluked the level from 78%.

levels.name: CONVULSION
levels.author: femboy
levels.desc: The hardest 1.9GDPS level, taking on a red, black and blue colour scheme with very flashy visuals and a menacing atmosphere. Its gameplay is very learny with many fakes and structures blending in with the decoration, and features a difficult ship section halfway through.

levels.name: Subterminal Point
levels.author: SyQual
levels.desc: Generally underwhelming Trueffet sequel with classic SyQual visuals. Has an incredibly low enjoyment rating with appalling chokepoints and hitboxes, paired with a bubbly song.

levels.name: CHIL
levels.author: McCoco
levels.desc: A pure solo project which started out in early 2.2 and took over a year to verify. To fit its Camellia song, the visuals are extremely trippy with relentless camera effect usage and rapid pulses, which are especially apparent in the second half.

levels.name: Defeated Circles
levels.author: GXQ
levels.desc: A Nine Circles styled level which takes heavy inspiration from the "You So Defeated" challenges, being especially apparent in the level's timing-based segments and its song choice. The level is overall first-half heavy, though the difficulty does not step down much in the latter half, ending off on

levels.name: cognitohazard
levels.author: Mercury6779
levels.desc: The hardest and most skillset varied extreme demon that was made for MatMart GDCIV2, featuring 2 player parts, very spammy gameplay, a very original memory ship and random elements, it was designed specifically to not be beaten by anyone. It's atmosphere is based on a glitchy theme and an actual cog

levels.name: zorin
levels.author: Vodyanitsa
levels.desc: A 3-minute-long XL extreme known for having no spikes from start to finish. It features a vibrant color palette and a carefree-styled art aesthetic, paired with an array of very gimmicky gameplay mechanics. This level is fairly well-received for its difficulty.

levels.name: Prismline
levels.author: ItsHarryy
levels.desc: Colorful 2.2 glow level inspired by old glow levels. Also a semi-official sequel to Just DANCE with very similar gameplay and pacing, including the chokeable straight fly at the end.

levels.name: Sacrifice
levels.author: iiLaniakea
levels.desc: Laniakea's XL megacollab themed after the Touhou series. Heavily inspired by Artifice, it features various different pink and purple coloured design styles referencing the game it's based on. Has fast paced overall gameplay with the difficulty leaning toward the second half.

levels.name: Slaughterhouse
levels.author: IcEDCave
levels.desc: Former top 1 with some of the most iconic wave sections in the game. Memorable for how incredibly intimidating the gameplay is, paired with an extremely washed out menacing song, along with being previously hacked and beaten legit  2 months later.

levels.name: Sakupen Circles
levels.author: TheDiamondPizza
levels.desc: Flashy nine circles level known for its lack of balancing and iconic wave sections. Remake of the 1.9 impossible level of the same name, and was briefly top 1.

levels.name: Firework
levels.author: TrickGMD
levels.desc: Iconic greyscale former top 1 by CherryTeam. Loaded with classic sections like the red-orb ship and the difficult wave burst at 49%. Surprisingly not wave and ship carried.

levels.name: Through The Gates
levels.author: TeamTheDashers
levels.desc: An initially hacked-verified level in 2018 that went through several stages. Even though it was verified in 2023, it took another three years for the level to get rated alongside other historical levels. Some say this level is a spiritual successor to Thinking Space.

levels.name: Stellar Night
levels.author: IcEDCave
levels.desc: 2.1 solo extreme by icedcave. Notable for its thorny obstacles and deep-blue gradient color scheme. Would've been top 10 if rated upon release, however it never got rated until 4 years later. As such, it was the top 1 on the UDL for a decent amount of time.

levels.name: poocubed
levels.author: Liisp
levels.desc: The 3rd level in the poocu series, consisting of some of the most colorful and innocent decoration on the list. Known for its high-cps off-the-grid gameplay, as well as overall maximum bubbliness.

levels.name: MINUSdry
levels.author: CDMusic
levels.desc: Half-joke and half-serious old styled extreme. Remake of the impossible level "Silent Dry". Don't get wet...

levels.name: Saul Goodman
levels.author: Renn241
levels.desc: The hardest extreme in the Breaking Bad series, overall not supposed to be a serious level. Incredibly learny gameplay where everything is moving and bouncing, also filled to the brim with inside jokes. Atrocious endscreen.

levels.name: COMBUSTION
levels.author: Cersia
levels.desc: Claustrophobic 1.9 styled extreme with only about 50 seconds of gameplay. Created to be one of the hardest slow, timing based extremes at the time.

levels.name: Deadlier Clubstep
levels.author: herozombie80
levels.desc: Maximalist authentic 1.9 level with some of the densest decoration on the list. Vague remake of Deadly Clubstep and Silent Clubstep, mimicking the classic cube-ball dual. Has its fair share of edgy text sprinkled throughout.

levels.name: The Catacombs
levels.author: Cersia
levels.desc: Very old 1.9 GDPS level built as an upcoming top 1 in 2019. Was verified by Slithium in 2024, and rated in 2026.

levels.name: KOSETSU
levels.author: fwwe
levels.desc: Strange wintery realism collab with incredibly talented creators like Bli & Motheye. Uses an incredibly strange atmospheric song and goes a little crazy with 2.2 shaders.

levels.name: Apocalyptic Trilogy
levels.author: APTeamOfficial
levels.desc: Legendary but poorly received extreme that combines and superbuffs Cataclysm, Bloodbath and Aftermath. Took roughly 5 years to be finished and verified and has incredibly rough quality inconsistency.

levels.name: Silentlocked
levels.author: GDSkele
levels.desc: A nerfed remake of the iconic impossible level "Silentlocked", which was an absurdly buffed version of the main level "Deadlocked" that went viral in early 2.0. While some impossible parts were changed, such as the wave sections, some others remained untouched, like the orb spams.

levels.name: NOMAD
levels.author: ReeseVT
levels.desc: Using "Exit Music (For A Film)" by Radiohead for the song, Nomad is an extremely short and dense precision test with a mild runtime of 57 seconds, containing primarily desert and blizzard themes for its aesthetic. Has an interesting choice of gameplay, utilizing only three gamemodes: cube, ship, and

levels.name: Sevvend Clubstep
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Industrial, minimalist cherry team level that's pretty click-sync.

levels.name: Snowbound
levels.author: amplitron
levels.desc: Snow-themed XL solo extreme by amplitron, featuring an atmospheric art-design styled decoration. This level's pacing remains calm until the drop, where slow turns to flow, rapidly transitioning into fast-paced and High-CPS gameplay complementing its drum and bass track.

levels.name: Loops of Fury
levels.author: Enfur
levels.desc: Grayscale effect level that contains sections where the gameplay loops several times over (hence its name). Has a very chokeable ending.

levels.name: Voltage
levels.author: ThePurgatory
levels.desc: A yellow/orange electricity themed level created by The Purgatory team that took roughly four years to finish. Strangely it is pretty underground for its difficulty.

levels.name: Losing Your Mind
levels.author: GDgalaxygaming
levels.desc: 2.2 remake of Mind Control, complete with a combination of extremely gimmicky and traditional gameplay, featuring a fake dual wave at the drop, a pick-a-path corridor(s) at 63%, and a randomised ending. Decorated with a range of different decoration styles to match the original level.

levels.name: Solar Flare
levels.author: Linear2
levels.desc: A remake of Solar Circles, with warm colours and blue highlights. Consists of unique structuring and a lot of movements on the structures. Also features Janet, the sun at the halfway point.

levels.name: LIMBO
levels.author: MindCap
levels.desc: Legendary memory level hosted by MindCap. Built with the intention of providing a unique, different experience to players. The randomised key maze is perhaps most iconic ending in any extreme. One of the first extremes to have merch.

levels.name: The Hallucination
levels.author: SyQual
levels.desc: Black and blue circles level known for its intense song and fast-paced sync gameplay. Decoration took over a year to be completed.

levels.name: Edge of Destiny
levels.author: CDMusic
levels.desc: Beloved remake of classic extreme Blade of Justice. Stays very true to the original, but significantly enhances the decoration and buffs the gameplay into a bright and glowy masterpiece.

levels.name: Fracture
levels.author: Arrowgazi
levels.desc: A fast-paced indigo Nine Circles level that is a staple within the New Zealand Geometry Dash community. levels.name: BRITNEY NO SCLEARS
levels.author: wabas
levels.desc: A deceivingly difficult solo extreme that was inspired by SARY NEVER CLEAR and Hard Machine. Notable for its name and usage of a Britany Spears song. It took over a year to get rated.

levels.name: The Plunge
levels.author: Dolabill
levels.desc: Atmospheric and floaty vortex themed extreme with a washed out song that takes loose White Space inspiration. Very memorable endscreen with a realistic hand.

levels.name: Gaggatrondra
levels.author: MoistyJc
levels.desc: Bright and energetic level using Problem by Ariana Grande. Includes a memorable dual with intense and quirky high-cps gameplay. levels.name: Collapse
levels.author: rnexel
levels.desc: Colorful XL click-sync solo design level using the second half of Dimrain47's Infernoplex. Memorable for its flashy rainbow effects and song representation. Contains an entire 10 second dash-orb at 76% to optimize the amount of nerves. 🐟

levels.name: walter white
levels.author: Renn241
levels.desc: The 2nd hardest level in the Breaking Bad series, and arguably the least interesting. Consists of typical Renn241 styled decoration with great colours and a severe lack of move triggers.

levels.name: Sinister Silence
levels.author: Wahffle
levels.desc: 1.9 style extreme memorable for its nearly 9 minute runtime and incredibly large catalogue of creators. Utilizes a high-energy progressive rock song that easily gets your hands shaking as you progress.

levels.name: Mayhem
levels.author: LordVadercraft
levels.desc: Construction themed CherryTeam collab mostly memorable for its off-sync sync-based gameplay. The LDM is perhaps a little too strong...

levels.name: Damascus
levels.author: Dzeser
levels.desc: Incredibly large megacollab 3 years in the making in which many classic creators (such as Tygrysek and Rob Buck) would remake their own most important level to them as their part. A level serving as a collage of diverse creating styles and scattered memories over the years, and was fittingly release

levels.name: The Wonder of You
levels.author: HangerLord
levels.desc: Claustrophobic monochrome extreme with subtle blue/purple accents. Uses a memorably strange industrial song matching the unconventional name and detailed mechanical designs. Initially, it was supposed to be top 10, but was nerfed to roughly top 25 to prioritize playability.

levels.name: Belladonna
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Gameplay by Vernam, effects and structuring by Itami. Memorable for its flashy visuals and high-cps flow gameplay.

levels.name: Climax
levels.author: HushLC
levels.desc: Typical purple glow-flow extreme heavily inspired by Kyouki, using the same song.

levels.name: Decks Dark
levels.author: MadisonYuko
levels.desc: An atmospheric Lotus Flower inspired level that uses only UFO, ship, duals, and a Radiohead song of the same name. levels.name: SARYYX NEVER CLEAR
levels.author: aartos
levels.desc: SARY NEVER CLEAR and Hard Machine inspired design extreme with bright colors and heavy 1.9 influence. Gameplay is also loosely inspired by the aforementioned levels, with tight straight-fly and multiple brief spam sections.

levels.name: Midnight
levels.author: MadisonYuko
levels.desc: An extremely flashy, fast-paced and high cps sequel to Twilight. Consists of a vague space theme and brief misaligned dual section. Supposedly a collage of Yuko's older levels.

levels.name: PSYCHOPATH
levels.author: DeniPol
levels.desc: Extremely unique extreme with a vague asylum and hallucination theme. The level's concept has supposedly been floating around since 2019. Caused controversy by being unrated after the verification was found to be using click between frames.

levels.name: The Yangire
levels.author: Dorami
levels.desc: Well-received sequel to The Yandere. Inconsistent but incredible art and designs with parts almost 3 years old before being finished. Took over 130,000 attempts to be verified.

levels.name: Operation Evolution
levels.author: Halzion
levels.desc: A 5 minute long megacollab intended to be the hardest 1.9PS level of its time, starting in 2022 as a layout collab before growing to have a roster of 25 decorators. One of its most notable gameplay sections is the very end containing an extremely stressful and chokable combination of a ship control

levels.name: Wavterminal
levels.author: Skyavoxii
levels.desc: Vibrant & hyper-saturated level that takes full advantage of shaders and gradient triggers. Includes spirals of swirling colors pairing well with its energetic song. One of most enjoyed extremes in the top 150!

levels.name: ORDINARY
levels.author: vit12
levels.desc: Bright and flashy early 2.2 extreme with a classic The Living Tombstone song that gets awkwardly pitched down at 59%. Generally very poorly received by victors. forgive no run please stop die haha

levels.name: Delta
levels.author: Drakosa
levels.desc: Intensely colorful and very sleek design megacollab hosted by Drakosa and Artsiburn. High-cps spinoff of the greek letter series (Gamma, Sigma & Omega) and memorable for its flashy effects and incredible colors. Also features a very satisfying drop-down out of the section at 67% into a new one to th

levels.name: Trickshot
levels.author: vonic
levels.desc: Vonic's participation for Twister's #DemonTime event, where participants each made a demon of any difficulty by a certain due date. levels.name: arcturus
levels.author: maxfs
levels.desc: Dark hell-themed level with a song straight out of a horror movie. Recognizable for its iconic fast-paced wave sections and 16% of the level being a black screen. Formerly an impossible level, and was part of the triple top 1 rate alongside Slaughterhouse and Firework.

levels.name: Doppler
levels.author: At242
levels.desc: Splitscreen two player level with a distinct red and blue scheme in reference to the Doppler Effect. Created and verified by At424 & Latezk in two weeks! Memorable for its tech theme and satisfying clicksync. Currently the most enjoyed two player level.

levels.name: Sanctity
levels.author: amplitron
levels.desc: An Amplitron solo with a distinct red, city theme featuring a song from Bôa's hit album, Twilight. It focuses on small wave chokepoints and ship control gameplay. The level is known to be second half heavy with the city-like ending being most of the difficulty; the ending is also regarded as Amplitr

levels.name: Natural Disaster
levels.author: iIiLaSeRiIi
levels.desc: Formerly impossible flashy green extreme with a vague nature/jungle theme. Features incredibly fast-paced wave sections and fast-paced gameplay. Stolen assets were found in the original version of the level, leading to the level getting unrated and getting a redecoration. Respect the Planet.

levels.name: Jigsaw
levels.author: NEKONGAMES
levels.desc: Learny high-cps level themed around the Saw movie series. Features a stacked cast of realism and effect creators with an overwhelming amount of sharp objects and edgy text throughout. Particularly memorable for it's clean transitions and background effects.

levels.name: Tartarus
levels.author: ItzDolphy
levels.desc: Infamous 1.9 styled megacollab with a long history of verifiers, a revamp, and controversies. A remake of the impossible level Silent Akbar. Reigned as an overwhelmingly intimidating top 1 for more than 17 months.

levels.name: Sonic Wave Infinity
levels.author: APTeamOfficial
levels.desc: Superbuffed Sonic Wave remake hosted by APTeam and Riot. 5 verifiers were involved and the level was briefly unrated because of its infamous 69% crash trigger that could corrupt save data. Supposedly, Riot hosted this megacollab because he felt the original Sonic Wave was "boring".

levels.name: Oblivion
levels.author: dice88
levels.desc: Claustrophobic and colourful sequel to the equally claustrophobic Cognition. Loses the old fashioned style song for a more upbeat Creo song, similar to Carcano. Surprisingly one of the most dropped extreme verifications, going through 6 verifiers.

levels.name: The Golden
levels.author: BoBoBoBoBoBoBo
levels.desc: Legendary green and yellow jungle themed extreme that reigned as top 1 for over 100 days. Known for its extremely difficult wave sections and dark atmosphere. A remake of LMAnubis' El Dorado that very nearly didn't exist. I verified the golden lets go

levels.name: Fragile
levels.author: EndLevel
levels.desc: Megacollab and superbuffed combination of kowareta and unrated extreme Shibireta. Many community members on Twitter were advocating for Fragile to get rated, starting the popular #RateFragile hashtag.

levels.name: Verdant Landscape
levels.author: ItzNisha
levels.desc: A pure solo level built and verified over the course of two years. Taking heavy inspiration from Windy Landscape, it features a green colour scheme, fast-paced, flowy gameplay and mesmerising Woogi-style symmetrical duals. Highly praised amongst the community for its fun gameplay and charming visual

levels.name: Henken
levels.author: PLoLek
levels.desc: A megacollab with an entirely Polish creator roster notable for its muted colours, timing-based gameplay and difficult wave sections near the end. Much of the difficulty also lies in the first half, and contains the occasional fixed hitbox here and there.

levels.name: The Paroxysm of Rage
levels.author: Zacanaii
levels.desc: Superbuffed remake of Paroxysm to the point of almost copying. Slightly upgrades the visuals, and adds an extension with some glitchy effects.

levels.name: Terminal Rampancy
levels.author: Xyriak
levels.desc: Xyriak's magnum opus that was worked on for over 3 years. It is extremely frantic with its gameplay and consists complicated usage of the dual mode, making it difficult to approach and learn. Unfortunately does not use the robot game mode.

levels.name: Cimmerian Shade
levels.author: spcreat
levels.desc: Extremely early 2.1 former impossible level that got rated completely out of the blue. Consists of unusual gameplay and a completely invisible section at 90%.

levels.name: NETWORK
levels.author: Agat3
levels.desc: Fast-paced greyscale neo-design collab acting as a sequel to the easier Framework. Contains a memorably tricky spider at 55%

levels.name: VOID
levels.author: nikoberry
levels.desc: A blue space themed extreme demon that took nearly a year and a half to get rated. Its song and decoration make for a cozy atmosphere, with the intensity picking up in a brutal ship section that spans over half the levels length, and also considered to be the hardest ship part in any rated level.

levels.name: Checked Steam
levels.author: gruzyGD
levels.desc: Landscape themed and visually cozy level with a really large infamous reputation due to it's brutal gameplay, which is generally carried by very awkward sections and absurd spammy parts like the blue spam at the beginning, the majority of the wave (including the also mega infamous mini wave coin spa

levels.name: Coalescence
levels.author: amplitron
levels.desc: Fast-paced and intriguing fusion of extremes Fog and Shimmer. Consists of an entire minute of 4x speed gameplay. The song is also a collab by the artists involved in the two levels combined here. Features a randomised ending that is much more complex than the one found in Fog.

levels.name: limbo but uwu ig idk
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: Really bright and blinding rainbow level with a crazy wave teleporting maze at the end of it.

levels.name: paranoia
levels.author: amplitron
levels.desc: An Amplitron solo with a floral theme that features a PinkPantheress song. It focuses primarily on high CPS with an abundance of triple clicks and difficult wave bursts. Contains a notable ship at 16% and is widely considered to be second half heavy.

levels.name: Starlit Stroll
levels.author: Enfur
levels.desc: Simplistic atmospheric level that gets more visually complex as it continues, eventually developing into a fast-paced psychedelic and starry swirl with a slower ending. Memorable for its few gamemodes but incredibly difficult ships, waves and swing sections.

levels.name: Make Paul Dance
levels.author: Bemq
levels.desc: The second spider-only extreme demon. Contains the titular Paul, as well as several nasty double and triple clicks that look like they're straight out of an impossible level.

levels.name: Heavenly Sakupen
levels.author: YouknowwhoGD
levels.desc: 1.9 GDPS extreme demon top 5 that is absurdbly unbalanced, featuring 2 extremely short wave parts where 90% of the difficulty lies in there, the first one being miles harder than the second one, and also containing a chokeable cube and ship parts between those 2 wave sections, being the rest of the

levels.name: chrome hearts
levels.author: roadkiller
levels.desc: Roadbose's sendoff to the ICE Carbon series; a core-styled level built in the 1.9GDPS with symmetrical structuring, abstract shapes and highly detailed designs. levels.name: Waterfall
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Legendary long awaited high-octane icy megacollab by CherryTeam. Known for its intense song and extremely high-effort and realistic art created by the likes of Bli, CuLuc and kivvvi. Originally was meant to be a Firework sequel.

levels.name: Shukketsu
levels.author: MadisonYuko
levels.desc: Learny Kowareta inspired "art-core" level with a groovy breakbeat song and colorful desaturated visuals. Features a slight garden theme and is flooded with community inside jokes and memes. The gameplay itself is clicksync and fast paced, with many chokepoints throughout the level.

levels.name: Aerial Gleam
levels.author: EndLevel
levels.desc: Bright blue storm themed circles level that gradually gets more decorated and flashy as it continues. Known for spawning the "CuLuC lightning" trend and for its difficult wave sections. Official sequel to Aquatic Auroras and the third level in the Weather Trilogy with 4+ verifiers.

levels.name: Critical Heat
levels.author: Zeniux
levels.desc: Fast-paced extreme themed around escaping a burning facility. Contains a lot of scaled up animated fire objects and high octane gameplay, along with a difficult dual. The hardest PEACEFUL! level in the game.

levels.name: Viprin UFO
levels.author: nothawkyre
levels.desc: Retro 1.9 styled extreme that only uses the UFO gamemode. Gameplay is much harder than it looks due to the unpredictable click-patterns and sketchy routes. Includes an upbeat Waterflame song and references to Pacman and Flappy Bird levels.

levels.name: Trueffet
levels.author: SyQual
levels.desc: Memorable blue and pink SyQual extreme with extremely difficult ship, wave, and spam sections. Originally was top 3 (even technically being top 1) and features numerous iconic high-cps wave sections. Named after Trueffet Square from Maple Story.

levels.name: BEELINE
levels.author: Galaxxyss
levels.desc: Very vibrant splitscreen 2 player level with the parts being references to various games. Includes some tricky and fast-paced gameplay, with the beginning being the hardest one.

levels.name: ATOMIC CANNON Mk III
levels.author: LIEB
levels.desc: The third installment of the ATOMIC CANNON series and the first to include features from the 2.2 update. levels.name: BPATA MPAKA
levels.author: Inex
levels.desc: A 2.2 Russian Mega-collab originally made to be a top 1, which was later changed. The level is based on the novel Master and Margarita.

levels.name: UNKNOWN
levels.author: NineDice
levels.desc: Redecoration of the 1.9 styled level of the same name. The completely greyscale decoration and unnerving song makes for a generally unsettling experience. Also one of the shorter extremes on the list, being less than 45 seconds.

levels.name: Kenos
levels.author: npesta
levels.desc: 2019 buffed and extended remake of Sakupen Hell. Formerly top 2 and has some terrible hitboxes and 4+ verifiers. Received unparalleled attention at the time for the verifier npesta's insane reaction became a meme across the internet.

levels.name: Crystal Crusher
levels.author: Zeniux
levels.desc: Simplistic crystal cave themed extreme. Majority of the level features convoluted and long misaligned duals.

levels.name: Starlight Summit
levels.author: hazelmrow
levels.desc: A pure solo extreme using only the robot gamemode where the player traverses through treacherous alpine terrain. levels.name: Hard Machine
levels.author: komp
levels.desc: Iconic design level with unchanged gameplay originally made in 1.8 in an effort to be harder than ICE Carbon Diablo X. Infamous for its 46% "shalom" mini-ufo spam among other difficult sections.

levels.name: Widestep
levels.author: Demishio
levels.desc: Blue and purple design level with early 2.1 adjacent designs. Features incredibly fast-paced gamemode switches and difficult timings. Apparently one of the hardest solo-created and verified levels of its time. The Lucky Potion Has No Effects On Gameplay.

levels.name: Keres
levels.author: ItsHybrid
levels.desc: Extended and buffed Erebus remake with a large roster of creators. Primarily timings-based with complex and awkward gameplay throughout.

levels.name: Esfera
levels.author: SyQual
levels.desc: Fast-paced Korean megacollab using a primarily blue and pink color scheme. Over 4 minutes long and memorable for its inconsistent style and bubbly song, as well as its fast-paced gameplay and chokepoints.

levels.name: WOBBLING MACHINE
levels.author: Smarted
levels.desc: 2 player extreme where one player has to perform standard gameplay as the other player clicks in a repetitive pattern, matching the rhythm of the 'wobbling' technique in Smash Bros. levels.name: IRIS
levels.author: KazaGD
levels.desc: A rapid-paced extreme collab which contains mainly vibrant blue, purple and pink coloring and a variety of eye-catching effects that capture the intensity of the level's song. The gameplay is very well-regarded despite the challenge it provides. The wave parts are considered to be the most difficult

levels.name: NEUTRA
levels.author: Jenkins
levels.desc: Extremely frantic and high-energy level with incredibly flashy effects and designs. Contains a memorable dual wave at 23% along with other quirky click-sync gameplay gimmicks and a very hard ending. The music collective 'siximpala' created the song and significantly helped plan the level's visuals.

levels.name: Judgement Knights
levels.author: HangerLord
levels.desc: The sequel to Knights of Thunder, featuring flashy colors and an extremely intense song. Memorable for its unique colors and futuristic city-themed visuals. Often abbreviated to JKOT.

levels.name: DISSONANCE
levels.author: ivyteal
levels.desc: A solo effect level created to match its dissonant song, standing out amongst other levels around its difficulty with its slow, precision-based gameplay and bizarre effects. Received a legendary rating from RobTop.

levels.name: Crackhead Circles
levels.author: AlrexX
levels.desc: Extremely bright and flashy rainbow circles level by AlrexX. Represents the ridiculous mumble trap-metal song with psychedelic visuals and high-energy timings. Don't do drugs

levels.name: Scream Machine
levels.author: TMco
levels.desc: 3-minute-long horror themed megacollab with great immersion and various creepy pop culture references. Features unique gameplay and decoration heavily inspired by 2.0.

levels.name: Axinie
levels.author: SaturMan
levels.desc: Semi-generic early 2.2 extreme using a flashy bright pink and blue color loop throughout the level. Consists of high-cps timings and multiple swing sections.

levels.name: Ascent
levels.author: Rimexon
levels.desc: Short neon-green glow megacollab with flashy pulses and difficult ship and wave sections. Features an incredibly laggy realistic endscreen and a very loose forest theme.

levels.name: Swing Swing
levels.author: KazaGD
levels.desc: A swing-only extreme demon with a super creative name hosted by Kaza. Went unrated for a really really long time

levels.name: azure blast
levels.author: AlbinoSnail
levels.desc: An entirely Korean megacollab with a blue colour scheme and very difficult flow gameplay. The first list level to use a song from the game's

levels.name: ROCKBOTTOM
levels.author: Bimms
levels.desc: A more brighter and colorful SUPERHATEMEWORLD remake, intended to be mainlist upon the time of its release. levels.name: Dark Dimension
levels.author: ThePurgatory
levels.desc: A controversial superbuffed redecoration of Black Blizzard. It had a lengthy multi-year creation process with several parts being upgraded or completely revamped in 2.2. The level faced heavy criticism from the community for its quality and originality.

levels.name: Goober Rage Stage
levels.author: bonscarrot
levels.desc: Medium length, Robot-only memory level with lots of trolls that have to be memorised and subsequently avoided. Well known and quite well received.

levels.name: GLUNGUS ADVENTURES
levels.author: Bimms
levels.desc: Extremely serious level based off of the infamous Glungus. From randomized minigames and an evil pong battle to multiple bossfights against Glungus himself, GLUNGUS ADVENTURES truly does whatever it wants. "All i know is that Glungus Adventures is a MOVIE!" - Conix

levels.name: Zodiac
levels.author: BIANOX
levels.desc: Legendary former top 1 that was hack verified by xander556 before being verified legitimately by Technical. Features a classic Creo song, bright but simplistic visuals, and infamous chokepoints.

levels.name: Promethean
levels.author: EndLevel
levels.desc: Medium length orange hell level with an intense metal song and a multitude of clubstep monsters. Notorously ship-carried and has a note-worthily difficult ending. Took over 115,000 attempts to verify.

levels.name: ConClusion
levels.author: DreamZoneGD
levels.desc: The final and hardest level of the ConTrilogy. This level holds nothing back and utilizes memory to its fullest while including flashbacks from both ConTroller and ConFusion. The wave part is known for being very intimidating to approach and can be considered one of the most intense parts of a memor

levels.name: Cold Sweat
levels.author: para
levels.desc: Legendary but ultimately aged effect level with an incredibly memorable spam ufo and high-cps wave part at 61%. Previously was top 7 and was one of the best top levels of its time, also being heavily memed by the community for years.

levels.name: Thinking Space
levels.author: Atomic
levels.desc: Former impossible level known for its extreme difficulty spike in the final third. Incredibly unique in terms of both its gameplay and decoration, featuring absolutely absurd chokepoints and a backwards-moving wave part, a clear product of early 2.0.

levels.name: Renevant
levels.author: nikroplays
levels.desc: Allegiance sequel with a darker aesthetic than its predecessor. Features flowy muscle-memory gameplay and a surprising amount of quick UFO sections, along with occasional chokepoints throughout. They also misspelled the name

levels.name: Lotus Flower
levels.author: StarkyTheSalad
levels.desc: Beloved gimmicky neo-design level by duo zzzgecko and StarkyTheSalad. Known for its insanely difficult to control duals and Radiohead song, as well as its washed out and laid-back visuals.

levels.name: Calculator Core
levels.author: Walroose
levels.desc: Classic 2019 megacollab remaking and extending TeamN2's Artificial Ideology. Extremely difficult for its time, and stays true to the original while upgrading the decoration and doubling the length. Primarily greyscale with fast-paced gameplay very reminiscent of early 2.1.

levels.name: qoUEO
levels.author: GhostVandalf
levels.desc: Foggy neo-design-esque level memorable for its balancing, all the difficulty being in the first 26% in the form of an ultra-precise challenge-like wave part. Often referred to as "an extended challenge list level".

levels.name: Sky Shredder
levels.author: dorvict
levels.desc: Formerly the hardest 1.9GDPS extreme. Mostly monochromatic and remains high-energy through most of the level, with difficult ship and wave parts. The name comes from a Bloons TD 6 Monkey Ace upgrade. "The bloons will wish they had never come..."

levels.name: Lithium
levels.author: L4TeZk
levels.desc: Sleek memory-based extreme with gimmicky gameplay and classic desaturated designs. The gameplay is note-worthy for its incredible amount of learniness and unique structuring.

levels.name: Crimson Planet
levels.author: TrueOmega
levels.desc: Legendary former top 1 with an intense dubstep song and a loose otherworldly theme. Incredibly reminiscent of early 2.1, being started only months after 2.1's release. levels.name: Dry Out Copyable 2
levels.author: tenzk
levels.desc: Very long and colorful reddit extreme memorable for its unique effects and many pop-culture and GD references. levels.name: ATOMIC CANNON Mk II
levels.author: LIEB
levels.desc: The second installment of the ATOMIC CANNON series made a year after the prequel. levels.name: Axiom Asterism
levels.author: Filqh
levels.desc: The captivating chromatic sequel to Infinite Inversion, this former list demon is centered around high CPS flow gameplay, with vivid inspiration from The Hallucination, with a high enjoyment rating contrasting with the former.

levels.name: Trotil
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Glass themed megacollab often mistaken for a winter theme, as the difference is pretty much impossible to differentiate. levels.name: Frost Spirit
levels.author: Quaybus
levels.desc: XL 1.9 styled extreme excellently capturing an icy cold environment within it's restrictions. The levels difficulty is primarily in its difficult cube and ship sections. Level name and song are from Tower Defense Simulator on Roblox.

levels.name: Guideless Goobering
levels.author: Enfur
levels.desc: Colorful rainbow memory level acting as the finale in the Enfur's Entourage trilogy. Features lots of bright and cluttered decoration and unique effects. Memorable for its tricky misaligned dual at 77%

levels.name: Disconnected Descent
levels.author: TheSkeletonGMD
levels.desc: Joke Digital Descent remake originally conceived by NLW to successfully prank AREDL. levels.name: Porridge Factory
levels.author: pootys1337
levels.desc: 1.9PS Oblivion inspired megacollab with medium length clicksync gameplay, using Red Haze by Creo. Had a planned nerfdate that never ended up coming out.

levels.name: DOUBLE DYNAMO
levels.author: spark
levels.desc: A gimmicky 2 players level featuring unique parts like the beginning, where the screen moves like an elevator, revealing parts you're about to enter, a symmetrical and asymmetrical ship, a "tax evasion" swing copter (one after another) and a "the prohibited meat" inspired ending (tight ship and wave

levels.name: shimmer
levels.author: amplitron
levels.desc: Incredibly fast-paced green and pink extreme for Zeroniums 2023 creator contest. levels.name: Tenkai
levels.author: HidekiX
levels.desc: Hideki's two player level that went unrated for years; features solo gameplay for the first 40%, and a dual for the rest of the level.

levels.name: DIRECTIONS

levels.desc: Unique XL level with a loose northern lights theme in the beginning, turning into a fast-paced and more modern-esque flurry of color. levels.name: We Are Not The Same
levels.author: mbed
levels.desc: 2-player duo collab where player 2's part is extreme and player 1's is significantly easier to the point of non-demon gameplay, hence the name. Consists of themeless and pretty low-key visuals, including a review about the mario movie at end. I don't think we're alike at all Mr. White...

levels.name: Instinct
levels.author: Krazyman50
levels.desc: Unofficial part of the Pokemon Go series (Valor & Mystic) and features yellow and black electric designs, remaining somewhat simplistic throughout. Memorable for its charm and inconsistent style. Generally more experimental than ItsHybrids' Instinct.

levels.name: SUPERHATEMEWORLD
levels.author: IcEDCave
levels.desc: Redecorated version of a 1.9GDPS impossible level by Icedcave which uses the main theme to Resident Evil. levels.name: Neon Skyline
levels.author: reshiria
levels.desc: City-themed extreme with a neon theme, hence the name. Notable for its timing-based gameplay, idiosyncratic structuring, and the fact that it was verified 3 years after it was originally finished.

levels.name: Cosmic Cyclone
levels.author: APTeamOfficial
levels.desc: APTeam's standout project, acting as the sequel to Sonic Wave. Consists of exceedingly bright effects and flashy space-themed designs similarly to Sonic Wave Infinity. Took 4 years to be created and verified, starting in 2017.

levels.name: Rigel
levels.author: Dan2D
levels.desc: Solo created and verified, space-themed Nine Circles level in tech style. The waves are constantly 4x speed, with the first one being far harder than the second. Has a very chokable ending.

levels.name: Cognition
levels.author: EndLevel
levels.desc: Iconic claustrophobic former top 3 extreme with an old fashioned song featuring Charlie Chaplin's speech from The Great Dictator. Known for its incredibly precise gameplay, monochromatic visuals and dark atmosphere.

levels.name: SARY NEVER CLEAR
levels.author: IIKugelBlitZII
levels.desc: Incredibly un-serious remake of the 1.6 formerly-impossible level by Optic Sunflow under the same name with altered gameplay. The level's silly text and charming early 2.1-esque decoration enabled it to get heavily memed by the community. HOW ARE YOU CLEAR MY MAP???

levels.name: Lucid Nightmares
levels.author: CairoX
levels.desc: 2.1 rainbow design collab by CairoX and DonutTV, was the second hardest verified level at the time. First level in a trilogy, the others being Lucid Chaos and Infinite Chaos. Official version was heavily nerfed due to CairoX's requests, unnerfed version is approximately top 50.

levels.name: Akashic Records
levels.author: VotcHi
levels.desc: Korean space-themed megacollab by Zeta, known for its variety in part theming. levels.name: RUTHLESS
levels.author: SurJaco
levels.desc: A highly decorated XL level with a slow pre-drop that makes up around 60% of the gameplay. The current version of the level was nerfed from the original to remove chokepoints; however, a lot of the difficulty still comes from the chokepoints that remain!

levels.name: SAND SAILOR
levels.author: Custi
levels.desc: Psychedelic-themed dual and timing level by Custi. Predrop consists of mostly triple spikes and dash orbs, and almost the entire last third of the level consists of an asymmetrical dual. Inspired by loltad and skywalker14's works, and Black Blizzard.

levels.name: CORRODERE
levels.author: Moosh
levels.desc: Design megacollab by Moosh that mixes 1.9 with modern creating techniques such as moving objects and trigger orbs. Famous for having a fat wave at 85%.

levels.name: ULTRA dimension
levels.author: handsomeorange
levels.desc: Almost 6 minutes of non stop memory gameplay. Be very afraid...

levels.name: Scrubbabingo force
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: A memory extreme which started off as a buffed version of Hexagon Force by Shubhy before being decorated and polished into a full level by Akunakun 3 years later. levels.name: meow hard
levels.author: meowdead
levels.desc: Hexagon force themed level with plenty of cats around, with very hard timing gameplay that concludes in a pretty creative wave at the ending.

levels.name: ta1LSD0ll
levels.author: ta1lsdoll
levels.desc: Extremely short and hyper-flashy effect level with incredibly learny wave sections. Constructed to be as psychedelic and otherworldly as possible greatly assisted by 2.2 shader spam. Unique endscreen by the mysterious 2003Devin.

levels.name: obsession
levels.author: jbooster
levels.desc: An insanely cool-looking jbooster solo that contains wonky, but enjoyable gameplay. Most notably known for surviving only 48 hours on the Demon List before being moved to legacy.

levels.name: Cycles X
levels.author: vortrox
levels.desc: The third and hardest level from Vortrox's series of superbuffed main levels, which was verified by it's own, that is also a megacollab with notable parts including the water themed at the end and the creator contest part at the beginning. levels.name: RUST
levels.author: neigefeu
levels.desc: A solo timing-based extreme formerly in the Top 20 which became highly popular among demonlist players for its accessibility. levels.name: Cobwebs
levels.author: NineDice
levels.desc: The shortest extreme in the game. Notable for its Halloween-esque theme and challenge-like gameplay. Was originally unrated for around 3 years, and received a bugfix when it got rated.

levels.name: Call Me Maybe
levels.author: nothawkyre
levels.desc: A pink extreme demon with many designs reflecting the simpler, traditional side of Geometry Dash, paired with an early 2010s pop song. Its gameplay is very clicksync based and relies on player movements to sync with the song, alongside especially brutal chokepoints in the ending and the predrop.

levels.name: Shardscapes
levels.author: ItzKiba
levels.desc: Minimalist-style timing-based extreme using only the robot gamemode. Its gameplay is notable for its usage of spike corner jumps and multi-activated orbs, and its decoration combines parallax, enter/exit effects and a calm Creo song to create a dream-like atmosphere.

levels.name: Coral Cave
levels.author: awesomeme360
levels.desc: A unique 2.1 level themed around a stage from the game Sonic Rush Adventure that goes by the same name. Features a memorable deco style, generally well received yet quirky gameplay involving double clicks, and a ring collecting and monster killing gimmick to obtain the coins.

levels.name: NYUTOPIA
levels.author: Tornabro
levels.desc: Fast-paced glowy design level that wears its hazy, Icedcave-inspired atmosphere on its sleeve. Contains an incredibly difficult first half with brutal waves and well-liked flowy clicksync gameplay throughout.

levels.name: Fever Dream
levels.author: IcEDCave
levels.desc: A 2.1 Devil Vortex inspired solo-created extreme demon known for its intimidating yet satisfying gameplay. Features ridiculous high cps wave corridors and hard timings. Due to this, the level has a very wide range of difficulty opinions. Has been redecorated and buffed several times.

levels.name: Omega Interface
levels.author: Platnuu
levels.desc: The final entry in Platnuu's "Interface" level trilogy, featuring dense, grayscale design decoration with flashes of bright red. Contains claustrophobic gameplay that emphasizes the intensity of the song.

levels.name: Gloxinia
levels.author: solarion
levels.desc: A mostly Korean Mega-collab started in late 2022 by  Aeidux and later finished by Solarion. Gloxinia feature early 2.1 style deco  similar to Zodiac and Esfera. The level contains flow gameplay and is an XL spanning just over 2 minutes.

levels.name: Nabil Let Go
levels.author: nabbbbbb
levels.desc: A 1.9 GDPS level which fittingly uses the main level song Can't Let Go. Initially starting out as a joke level, it has gone through many buffs and nerfs during its creation and consists of several wave chokepoints and a significant focus on timings. Contains a Jeff the Killer cameo.

levels.name: the ocean of fish
levels.author: shmigels
levels.desc: Solo XXL extreme containing many fish and other sea creatures made of spikes and other basic gd blocks. levels.name: CONNECT
levels.author: MCres
levels.desc: A deeply emotional and symbolic level originally intended to be a suicide note, portraying the creator's struggle with depression and suicidal ideation. Each part has direct references to the creator's feelings and experiences, and eventual recovery.

levels.name: Deep Bass
levels.author: Wespdx
levels.desc: An official sequel to Down Bass, with extremely challenging wave segments — most notably at 48% and 56% — followed by a significantly easier second half.

levels.name: Ragnarok
levels.author: Knobbelboy
levels.desc: An XXL megacollab 3 years in the making. The level doesn't follow a consistent theme, but it stands out with a darker color palette and design, with its intensity picking up in the second half. Its balancing didn't age very well, with the second half being notably harder, specially Enlex's part.

levels.name: Deimos
levels.author: EndLevel
levels.desc: A redecorated, buffed remake of the unnerfed version of Phobos. There is a different endscreen if you jump right before the last dual.

levels.name: The Art of the Blade
levels.author: mbed
levels.desc: The winner of MatMart's GD Civilization Contest thanks to its ludicrous gimmick of a randomized maze where the correct path is determined by the colour of three subtle details throughout the level. Even outside of its gimmick, the level features very unorthodox gameplay structuring and frontloaded b

levels.name: Launchpad Labyrinth
levels.author: Moffe
levels.desc: A fully half-speed level based on a level in the game “Wario Land: Shake It!” with the same name. The gameplay is intended to be annoying, being similar to the game's level. The level was originally hack verified.

levels.name: Moving Forward
levels.author: crohn44
levels.desc: The sequel to Glide and crohn44's final level, made over the course of two years. levels.name: Ykds1479ymdppr
levels.author: Kapycta999
levels.desc: A former list extreme themed around sleep paralysis. Its uncanny SFX and shader usage compliment its theme really well. The gameplay is mostly clicksync based with it culminating to a brutal ending wave part, followed by a nerve wracking final click.

levels.name: Horros
levels.author: Shrc
levels.desc: A 2-player level that has no consistent theme, as there is "no sense of continuity in dreams". For 2-player play it is borderline extreme demon gameplay, and has been rated as insane demon in the past.

levels.name: me when machine gang
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: A 2-player memory level by akunakun that was made in one sitting, with mostly path-based memory other than the splitscreen dual.

levels.name: DsinK
levels.author: stanstanmansan
levels.desc: A sink themed level that was originally started by crohn44, but then finished by Nightning and stanstansmansan. The gameplay is unconventional and gimmicky, with a desynced dual part and tricky timings throughout. Drop to the ending is mostly synced with the song.

levels.name: Jesse Pinkman
levels.author: Renn241
levels.desc: The first installment of the Breaking Bad Series, featuring typical fast-paced gameplay and an early 2.1 style aesthetic. levels.desc: Robbed Top 1 verified way back in 2017 that took nearly 9 years to get rated. Features several incredibly difficult wave chokepoints and a black and white colour scheme.

levels.name: Terminux
levels.author: Aerae
levels.desc: The sequel to Eternal Moment, adopting a similar gameplay and visual style though more polished and modern in many ways. levels.name: LD50
levels.author: StarkyTheSalad
levels.desc: An incredibly learny level featuring fast click patterns and complex gameplay mechanics, such as the ending where the player must avoid breaking breakable blocks so they form a bridge over a pit of saws. levels.name: CITRA
levels.author: autechregd

levels.name: Visible Ray
levels.author: KrampuX
levels.desc: A 2.1 Korean megacollab that doesn't follow a specific decoration style. The gameplay is heavily unoptimized, with some questionable chokepoints, such as 59%. Surprisingly good for the time it was made in. The level's difficulty predominantly relies on the first half, with there also being a difficu

levels.name: Asterios
levels.author: Exen
levels.desc: An old dual-heavy level hosted by Exen with an underlying space theme. Was initially built to be Top 1, but was heavily nerfed to be Top 20 at the time. Currently Exen's most well-received level thanks to its satisfying dual gameplay, though it being slightly held back by its predrop and bugs is a c

levels.name: Descent Into Exile
levels.author: GrenadeofTacos
levels.desc: A black and white extreme demon collab that it's acronym means "DIE". The level has some claustrophobic sections, making it very timing oriented, as well as some hard ship parts, where it is said that most of the difficulty lies in the second half, with some awkward timings and a dual part at the en

levels.name: Gustavo Fring
levels.author: Renn241
levels.desc: The second level in the Breaking Bad series. Primarily focused on tight ship, cube and flowy gameplay. It has somewhat inconsistent gameplay, and a very difficult first 30%. To avoid seeming racist, Renn didn't make a caricature like in the other Breaking Bad levels.

levels.name: the wiener
levels.author: Rynoxiouss
levels.desc: Goofy 2.1 pseudo-joke level that was made in a week. The level is generally not received very well, and the wave near the end is seen as one of the worst of all time. Features a two-block-long CDMusic part.

levels.name: Sides Of My Mind
levels.author: MaxxoRMeN
levels.desc: A 2-player level that splits apart and then recombines together in the end. Visuals contain a lot of contrasting effects and feature rainbow and monochrome palette.

levels.name: Excruciation Chamber
levels.author: spcreat
levels.desc: spcreat's (nearly) all wave level inspired by UFWM's challenge level, Torture Chamber. Decoration features a changing fire/frost theme.

levels.name: FRIDAY
levels.author: Metalface221
levels.desc: A very underground and niche former list demon with 1.9 styled decoration. Heavily inspired from WOOGI1411's style, and is primarily based on Colorful OverNight with similar colour palettes, dual structures and clicksync gameplay.

levels.name: BarbarosFinaleFinale
levels.author: awesomeme360
levels.desc: A 2.2 solo joke remake of Barbaros Finale by Moffe, with similar, albeit harder and less straightforward gameplay compared to its predecessor, while being notorious for its brutal consistency CPS wave at 75%. Contains a short segment of "miss you" by shmigels.

levels.name: Sank
levels.author: Waterbound
levels.desc: The hardest rated cube-only level at the time of its release. Takes major inspiration from Dump and DsinK. Has precise orb timings, and some silly Spongebob characters near the end.

levels.name: Bloom
levels.author: zodycoder
levels.desc: A minimalist atmospheric XXL solo extreme that won $300 in KrmaL's Contest 3. Consists of slow paced, experimental gameplay, a terrifying learning curve, and some randomization. Its style takes great inspiration from a level of the same name by KrmaL in Soundodger+

levels.name: Bloodlust
levels.author: Knobbelboy
levels.desc: Legendary former Top 1 and remake of Bloodbath, expanding on its predecessor with a minute-long extension of fast-paced gameplay as well as many changes to existing gameplay and an overhauled visual style. Had a monumental verification taking Knobbelboy over 1.5 years, 120k attempts and 1000 hours o

levels.name: Fog
levels.author: notesxd
levels.desc: Very well received foggy level with fast muscle memory based gameplay and a simple randomiser at the end

levels.name: Knights of Thunder
levels.author: HangerLord
levels.desc: Space-themed extreme created by Hangerlord known for fast paced consistent gameplay and rapid transitions highlighting wave and ship. This level was inspired by Trueffet and Cosmic Cyclone.

levels.name: kowareta
levels.author: Gablor
levels.desc: Extremely short level which to some can feel impossible. The first green orb is maybe a little bit hard. The level that birthed the reta styled levels. Inspired by Plasma Pulse Finale.

levels.name: Awedsy
levels.author: sink
levels.desc: A 1.9 GDPS collaboration between SleyGD and Sink. Contains fast overall gameplay, awkward structuring and a chokeable last wave resulting in relatively mixed reception. Named after the similarly named level Sink by Awedsy.

levels.name: Jupiter My Favourite
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: A blue and yellow solo memory extreme with many doodle-like designs and a lot of wacky gameplay structures and gimmicks, most notably the 24% wave.

levels.name: no jokes
levels.author: theParadoxTeam
levels.desc: Short and very serious level with no silliness allowed. Known for its extremely concentrated difficulty and chokepoints. Are you brave enough?

levels.name: Nhelv
levels.author: SrGuillester
levels.desc: The decoration in this level uses a black, white, and red color scheme to mimic the music video for the song the level uses, Nhelv. It's a technical level, which starts the player off with cube and ship gameplay, then shoots them directly into a intimidating wave section that makes use of D blocks.

levels.name: ATOMIC CANNON
levels.author: LIEB
levels.desc: The first installment of the ATOMIC CANNON series and Lieb's first solo level after eight years. The level is inspired by Intercept by Viprin and features fast-paced and high cps gameplay. The final ball also references 8 levels Lieb collaborated on back in the 1.9 era.

levels.name: PROTON LAUNCHER
levels.author: Multiverse55
levels.desc: An ATOMIC CANNON styled level which started out as an entry for Lieb's ATOMIC CANNON Style Gameplay Creator Contest. Just like the level it is based on, it features very fast-paced high CPS gameplay with a heavy lean towards timings and a very nerve-wracking ending.

levels.name: Dump
levels.author: GiggsRH
levels.desc: A level made by GiggsRH and Koopazu. This level used to be the hardest cube-only level, featuring precise cube timings, chokepoints and an unforgiving second half. The song is made by the popular indie pop band Kero Kero Bonito. Anyone going for this will certainly have their cube skills put to test

levels.name: Silent Club
levels.author: Luqualizer
levels.desc: Former impossible level hack verified all the way back in 1.6, and reverified nearly 7 years later. Its best known for its brutal spam sections sprinkled through the first half. Not to be confused with Silent Clubstep.

levels.name: Iris of a Puppeteer
levels.author: EternaswipVMAX
levels.desc: A dark and slower paced level featuring some very tight gameplay, with a focus on waves. More learny than expected, partly due to jank, and also features a blind frame perfect at 49%.

levels.name: Pootis Engage XTREME
levels.author: AAAAAlex
levels.desc: 1.9 styled memory extreme leaning towards timing skillset. 14-19 and 59-100 (particularly 59-70) are often considered major chokepoints. Sequel to "Pootis Engage" by the same creator.

levels.name: End of the Universe
levels.author: fusion425
levels.desc: Edge of the World remake hosted by Fusion425, taking almost 2 years to complete. Retains EOTW's upbeat song, gameplay, and flashy blue/purple space-themed visuals. Gameplay is very well-received!

levels.name: Congregation
levels.author: Presta
levels.desc: A 3 minute long timing-based level with a long, slow-paced buildup and an intense, fast-paced climax whilst also having the lowest object density of any 2.1 extreme at the time. Due to its progression-based approach and its required skillsets, it became very devisive both in deco and difficulty opin

levels.name: Apotheosis
levels.author: XavT
levels.desc: Fast-paced glow extreme with flashy visuals throughout. Contains claustrophobic high-cps gameplay and contrasts dark details with saturated effects.

levels.name: EGO KILLING
levels.author: exactteam
levels.desc: A megacollab that was originally hacked, unrated, and reverified with no gameplay changes. This level is flooded with chokepoints and is infamous for the 78% 4x speed mini wave click. Don’t expect the greatest experience.

levels.name: Retention Redux
levels.author: gdNitrox
levels.desc: Faithful retention remake passion project aimed to capture the essence of the original. Inspired from the creator's experience beating Retention as a first extreme. Gameplay takes light inspiration from the original while being very well-received, and the decoration boosts the object density and vib

levels.name: X84
levels.author: XavT
levels.desc: Extremely fast-paced & high cps extreme with an intense Camellia song. Memorable for its relentlessly learny but renowned gameplay, paired with jittery effects and flashes. Could be described as "Xronier's distant cousin."

levels.name: Cersia Madness
levels.author: Cersia
levels.desc: 1.9 extreme using Stereo Madness with an incredibly learny dual at the drop and very skill based gameplay in the ending and predrop. It was the least enjoyed extreme on EDEL before it was raised after a mass group completion by around 20 people. It has many skips that make the level significantly mo

levels.name: Ploink
levels.author: Goobfrudla
levels.desc: Short, unserious level with a rainbow colour scheme and many jokes and references sprinkled throughout. Its gameplay is somewhat learny with its difficulty primarily coming from timing-based cube sections.

levels.name: The Yandere
levels.author: Dorami
levels.desc: Iconic former top 10 Dorami megacollab. Extremely unbalanced and quirky with many inconsistencies in both design and gameplay, with JonathanGD and Spectex’s parts infamous for being major difficulty spikes.

levels.name: Storming Summit
levels.author: IINimbusII
levels.desc: XL Celeste-themed megacollab featuring a variety of stages, references, and gimmicks from the original game. Very well-received decoration and learny gameplay, including a crazy dual at 70%. Just breathe.

levels.name: Arctic Lights
levels.author: Metalface221
levels.desc: A notoriously difficult nine circles level that was the top 1 hardest nine circles level when it was verified. This was a remake to Hyper Paracosm and is themed after the color pale blue. For a long time, this was known as the list demon many would beat first, like Cobwebs and Cognition. Best known

levels.name: Plasma Pulse Finale
levels.author: xSmokes
levels.desc: The finale of the Plasma Pulse series and a former Top 1, making it by far the hardest. It takes everything you’ve learned from the previous levels with various precise timings (some may be chokepoints), a complicated robot + cube dual, and a nerve-wracking ending that contains robot micro clicks. T

levels.name: Spectrum Cyclone
levels.author: lTemp
levels.desc: A fast-paced level with a lot of asymmetrical duals and sync-based click patterns, taking nearly 2 years to build and verify. Very well-received by the community with many deeming it as one of the most fun extreme demons in the game to this day.

levels.name: Calamity
levels.author: Awedsy
levels.desc: Formerly the second hardest 1.9 GDPS level. The gameplay is skill based and it's difficulty is carried by the two wave sections, as well as the hard dual at the end. The level was updated by Royen to be more forgiving.

levels.name: Frozen Cave
levels.author: TrueParadoxTeam
levels.desc: One of the hardest art-style extremes of its time, where the player must escape a collapsing cave high up in the frozen mountains. levels.name: Golden Club
levels.author: GDZenmuron
levels.desc: A solo extreme demon made over 1.5 years, and the last level made by Zenmuron before he stepped down from the game. The level involves the player entering and exiting a golden factory.

levels.name: network
levels.author: VanDerVals
levels.desc: Incredibly fast-paced medium length extreme featuring multiple different environments throughout its short playtime. Features difficult cube gameplay and 0 time for breaks

levels.name: WORSTBRAINMAP
levels.author: Bimms
levels.desc: Quirky silly memory extreme with very gimmicky parts, such as a The Art Of The Blade styled randomised wave maze, a ship part with bouncing orbs, a cutscene where you have to click to the music, and a DIRECTIONS esque slope cube. Are you a thinker?

levels.name: Alpha
levels.author: SirWafel
levels.desc: A traditional-styled level which has faced over 6 years of on-and-off building and countless buffs, nerfs and rebalances. Despite everything it went through it managed to become highly enjoyed amongst its victors. Very timing-based with the main highlight being the 39% dual, though it has several sh

levels.name: SHIP
levels.author: Cersia
levels.desc: The second rated ship-only extreme not afraid to throw evil swoops in every corner you look. Since it’s a Cersia level, it’s from the 1.9 GDPS. Also technically the shortest XL extreme. Beware of the Ship Swing Copter of doom.

levels.name: ROCKY ROAD
levels.author: arclightt
levels.desc: Fast paced, well-received timing extreme created by arclight & cdyzz.

levels.name: NULLGATE
levels.author: Antiprime
levels.desc: Solo extreme demon that is visually inspired by "Kyouki". It's gameplay is full based on buffer inputs except for some waves and 3 diagonal cube spams with blue orbs in the drop section, with also containing an asymmetrical dual in the second half, where one player is behind the other. The level is

levels.name: 0 Techno
levels.author: cherryteam
levels.desc: Cherryteam collab hosted by MinAY, 'designed to make your eyes bleed'. Verification video is a placeholder showcase

levels.name: agg challenge 18
levels.author: erzor
levels.desc: Lofi art extreme made for their friend agg's birthday. Contains many birds!

levels.name: bell
levels.author: rozengerj
levels.desc: Solo extreme with faithful, highly detailed core-styled decoration.

levels.name: Requiem
levels.author: Zylenox
levels.desc: The official sequel to the famous memory level “Killbot” and the most object dense rated level in GD.
