levels.name: Shutdown
levels.author: OliSW
levels.desc: This level has a hot/cold theme and is based around a map from Flood Escape 2. Has a brutal ship/wave at the drop and a difficult swing-copter near the middle of the level. There is also a memory part based on a previous level by OliSW, Ulon.

levels.name: Shirakami
levels.author: Zentraa
levels.desc: A Kowareta styled level megacollab.  The level has an open-world botanical style that separates it from the traditional Kowareta style. Sequel to the unrated level “Shiranai” made by the same host.

levels.name: RAM
levels.author: James
levels.desc: Extremely high-quality design megacollab themed around computer parts with wacky gameplay and cameos from notable creators like Smokes, para, and Giron. Has some questionable balancing and an alignment bug at 80%. Watch out for LIEB's red orb of doom.

levels.name: Ghoul
levels.author: XavT
levels.desc: One of XavT's solo extremes. Features intense and learny gameplay, with entirely grayscale decoration. This was formerly the hardest AREDL monthly extreme.

levels.name: FIFTY THREE
levels.author: Vlacc
levels.desc: A fast-paced, visually simple level, where the drop's gameplay is in mirror mode and cycles through all the gamemodes in chronological order (though skipping the robot). Due to a lot of effort put into balancing, it has become very enjoyed amongst its victors. One of the two Vlacc levels starting ou

levels.name: Hyper Paracosm
levels.author: iIiViRuZiIi
levels.desc: An early 2.1 collab between ViRuZ and TheRealSneaky. It's a Nine Circles level with purple and blue theming. It's known for its chokepoint heavy and awkward gameplay, especially at the beginning of the drop. Also contains a difficult ending.

levels.name: Glory
levels.author: EntiqueGD
levels.desc: A Christian megacollab hosted by Entique, intended to remind everyone of God's love and glory. The level itself is a purple glow-flow with an upbeat Colbreakz song.

levels.name: Cobalt hell
levels.author: RubrumP
levels.desc: Superbuffed glow-styled remake of the classic Easy Demon, Blue Hell. Contains hard timings, tight ship & wave gameplay and was originally much harder before the level received a balance update.

levels.name: Luminosity
levels.author: Enfur
levels.desc: Atmospheric light themed extreme creatively using pads, portals & jump-rings as decoration. Contains difficult swing sections and flowy orb-based gameplay with bright particle-based backgrounds.

levels.name: Wasureta
levels.author: HelpegasuS
levels.desc: A purple "reta-styled" level recognisable for its flow gameplay style, difficult wave sections and extremely high-CPS click patterns. Its emphasis on muscle memory has made it relatively accessible for its difficulty and hence its popularity among extreme demon players.

levels.name: ConTroller
levels.author: DreamZoneGD
levels.desc: DreamZone's first solo level and the first of the ConTrilogy. This factory themed level contains heavy amounts of memory with tons of fakes similar to some levels from the 1.9 era. The factory heats up during the drop and becomes very dynamic, so try not to get too controlled with the level's fast m

levels.name: In the Generator
levels.author: Gelforce
levels.desc: A solo extreme made in the 2.0GDPS. Has an upbeat electricity/factory theme with a very faithful 2.0 aesthetic. The gameplay is mainly skill based, with some very tight precision ship sections.

levels.name: Edge of the World
levels.author: L4TeZk
levels.desc: Atmospheric cosmic-themed extreme consisting of high-cps clicksync gameplay and clean designs/effects. Memorable for Flaxy's slanted part at 35% as well as the fantastic song choice.

levels.name: Devotion
levels.author: domi77
levels.desc: This 2.1 extreme is the second level in the Rededication Series, which is inspired by Nikrodox's Dedication series. This level has been in the works since 2018, initially being known as "Paradox".

levels.name: ADOMANIA
levels.author: Swib
levels.desc: Well received sequel to Ellipsism with a satisfying click pattern and very bright drop sections. The waves in the first drop are notably unbalanced, and the last click is a major chokepoint. Despite this, the level remains very well received.

levels.name: LUMINA
levels.author: Hechie
levels.desc: A timing-based level which takes heavy inspiration from Congregation, with similar progression style, structuring, and the same gamemodes. However, this level is more bright and much more fast-paced. Initially very first-half heavy before getting a nerfdate which made it more balanced.

levels.name: Honeycrisp
levels.author: PurplePyro
levels.desc: A 1.9-inspired solo extreme featuring first half-heavy gameplay, difficult fast-paced wave sections and many chokepoints.

levels.name: Cybernetic Crescent
levels.author: ViPriN
levels.desc: The third and final level of the Tech Trilogy. It bears a more modern spin to its decoration compared to its two predecessors, which is especially apparent in how creating styles have evolved since the trilogy's last instalment and a much newer Creo song. Its middle third is especially difficult, wi

levels.name: Sink
levels.author: Awedsy
levels.desc: A purple and orange extreme demon combining modern creating techniques and ideas with 1.9 editor limitations in the 1.9GDPS. Its gameplay mostly revolves around clicksync with the first two sections bearing a big chunk of the level's difficulty.

levels.name: Rage
levels.author: nSwish
levels.desc: A high-CPS level with 7 sections, one for each gamemode. The colour scheme for each section is based on the gamemode’s portal.

levels.name: Infinite Iniquity
levels.author: Flukester
levels.desc: Nearly 4-minute long sequel to Twisted Tranquility. It shares some similarities such as the beginning and the “Jetpack Mode” cube. The level is fast-paced throughout, testing the player’s nerve control.

levels.name: Edge of the Blade
levels.author: eiruni
levels.desc: Vaguely themed around the Legend of Zelda game series. Features all-around gameplay with balancing skewed towards the first half, along with a handful of difficult waves and some awkward gameplay throughout.

levels.name: Silentium Clavas
levels.author: Xolarzz
levels.desc: Remake of Silent Club that aims to balance the gameplay by nerfing spams and buffing most of the other clicks. Its deco highly depends on the player's colors. Currently remaining as one of the least played legacy list demons.

levels.name: Golden Flare
levels.author: krakow1918
levels.desc: XL memory + circles extreme heavily inspired by Golden Paracosm & Bausha Vortex. Features cluttered structuring and a consistent bright yellow palette, as well as a randomised ending. Its also Krakow's first rate!

levels.name: Dance of the Violins
levels.author: DrayTM
levels.desc: An old megacollab that was only recently completed and verified, still containing parts from old creators like Funnygame and Cyclic. The decoration is in the design style popular at the time, and the gameplay is infamous especially for the ridiculously hard wave by Cyclic at 14%.

levels.name: Tenochtitlan
levels.author: Alpha rainbow
levels.desc: Acropolis-styled level with a theme centered around the ancient Aztec city of the same name. It's very timing based, featuring a lot of hard cube and ball parts, as well as a kind of chokeable wave at the end. Rumoured to not be well placed due to lack of victors.

levels.name: SisuSonic
levels.author: RpgRaketti
levels.desc: Finnish megacollab inspired by the sonic series, started in 2018 and finished in 2024. The hardest but also possibly the most obscure sonic series spinoff.

levels.name: Controlled Chaos
levels.author: Zipixbox
levels.desc: Vibrant red & green 2.0-esque masterpiece. Memorable for its incredibly well-executed gameplay gimmicks and consistent, high-quality designs. Includes numerous instances of creatively moving and interactive gameplay as well as immersive technology-inspired backgrounds.

levels.name: lacy
levels.author: Enfur
levels.desc: Calm pink XL megacollab to the tune of Lacy by Olivia Rodrigo. Has an asymmetrical dual in the middle where your icon can land on your ship.

levels.name: Next Stage
levels.author: Zipixbox
levels.desc: Zipixbox and TMco collab that is the successor to Heavens Door. Inspired by the Stage 4 boss from I Wanna Kill The Kamilia 3, and a 2.0 level of the same name. Features flashbacks to various older levels in reference to the IWKTK3 bossfight, as well as fully randomized bullet hell styled parts.

levels.name: MONHEIM
levels.author: surveyor23
levels.desc: A 19 minute-long pure solo passion project to the tune of Sleep, one of Godspeed You! Black Emperor's most well-regarded tracks. The various environments, effects and designs that the level progresses through vaguely reflect surveyor23's own interpretation of the song, heavily influenced by her pers

levels.name: Yatagarasu
levels.author: TrusTa
levels.desc: One of the most iconic 2.0 megacollabs, and one of the most memorable Top 1s of all time despite only dethroning Sonic Wave for a short time.  Contains 3 minutes of stressful gameplay from start to finish, including an incredibly difficult predrop, and chokepoints throughout, including Michigun's fa

levels.name: Sonic Wave Rebirth
levels.author: Serponge
levels.desc: 2.0 remake of Sonic Wave with near identical gameplay and effects that have aged to varying degrees. Despite being extremely similar it is notably less enjoyable on average.

levels.name: Sonic Wave
levels.author: lSunix
levels.desc: One of the most famous extreme demons of all time, with a rich history and many remakes. An iconic blue circles level with three separate wave parts and a hard ball part in the predrop. Member of the first RGB trilogy.

levels.name: Kuzureta
levels.author: Teno
levels.desc: A "reta-style" megacollab using Yoru ni Kakeru by YOASOBI that has a notably lower CPS than its predecessors. Features a solid amount of clicksync, numerous wave chokepoints, and two blind transitions.

levels.name: Atmos
levels.author: Marwec
levels.desc: A second-half heavy Marwec level decorated by a multitude of art-style creators that went through several balancing updates. Features a randomized path at 35% before ramping up in difficulty for the rest of the level with mainly wave-focused asymmetrical duals and chokepoints.

levels.name: Sunset Sandstorm
levels.author: crohn44
levels.desc: Iconic crohn44 extreme which takes heavy inspiration from Black Blizzard. Known for the infamous click pattern at the beginning of the level.

levels.name: Dark Flare
levels.author: KeiAs
levels.desc: The final and hardest level by Lightning Collab Team, this megacollaboration has no defined decorative theme. It is best known for the part by Dotory that was significantly buffed by the verifier, Plusxenon.

levels.name: Tapwreck
levels.author: MrLorenzo
levels.desc: A claustrophobic timings-focused level with corridor gameplay, UFO spam, an infamous first wave with fixed hitboxes and an ending cube with near-blind timings.

levels.name: Icotact
levels.author: IcEDCave
levels.desc: A 48 second level started by ozpectro and finished by Icedcave and Nobody. It features a lot of fast paced gameplay and ends in an infamously difficult wave.

levels.name: Twisted Titanium
levels.author: ItsHybrid
levels.desc: Third and final level of the Tempered Steel trilogy. Verified by spcreat. (Video set as verification is a showcase)

levels.name: xo
levels.author: KrmaL
levels.desc: A simplistic, 1.0 style KrmaL level with minimalistic effects. Known for its first half difficulty, as well as the infamous 3% dash orb, and some particularly good sync! Because of the minimalistic decoration, this level sparked some controversy over whether it deserves to be rated.

levels.name: ASHES
levels.author: xHeiDax
levels.desc: A level reflecting the creator’s struggle with mental health. Starts off extremely difficult and becomes easier as it progresses. Features an exceptionally high cps.

levels.name: GONER
levels.author: Nightning
levels.desc: Nightning's magnum opus, serving as a collection of his thoughts and feelings during his creation process and taking inspiration from the "Blurryface" album by twenty one pilots. The decoration is entirely red, black and white, and the level builds up to a near-incomprehensible yet incredibly cathar

levels.name: super probably level
levels.author: alkali
levels.desc: A flashy, colorful memory level, once regarded as the hardest memory extreme demon and Alkali's first. Notable for messing with the player and being raised countless times on Pointercrate.

levels.name: Necromancer
levels.author: T G I
levels.desc: A superbuffed remake of Necropolis that has very similar structuring and color scheme to the original. The gameplay has received criticism for its forced difficulty.

levels.name: Molten Gear
levels.author: Knobbelboy
levels.desc: A continuation of Fusion Z. This level underwent major changes after Manix648 requested its cancellation, causing several creators to withdraw. Knobbelboy then hosted a creator contest to fill all the gaps of the older parts which couldn’t be used, hence the vast difference in quality between many p

levels.name: Nightshade
levels.author: YakobNugget
levels.desc: A very long and colorful memory megacollab that many famous creators have parts in. Was kept completely secret by everyone involved until its release in 2022. Considered one of the best list demons of its time, and was nominated for Best Extreme Demon in the GD Awards.

levels.name: of Ambrosia
levels.author: Renn241
levels.desc: An almost two-minute 2.1 level that—much like M A N I X and GO bird—requires you to play the level completely blindly. It heavily relies on decorative/song-related cues in order to complete the level, requiring you to straightfly at the beginning and hold/click precisely at certain wave, spider, UFO

levels.name: Erebus
levels.author: BoldStep
levels.desc: Member of the RGB, themed around radioactivity. While it's shorter in length than the other two levels of the trilogy, it makes up for it by having some of the most difficult raw gameplay for its time. Its gameplay is very skill-based with many difficult ship and wave sections sprinkled throughout s

levels.name: Nunri
levels.author: Szilu
levels.desc: Szilu's hardest solo level, a purple design level which is well balanced and uses most gamemodes.

levels.name: Friday Vortex
levels.author: Cersia
levels.desc: A 1.9GDPS Nine Circles level that was later uploaded on the 2.1 servers with some visual changes. Has also some similarities to the other "vortex" Nine Circles levels like the wave structuration and sync, feeling like if it was a sequel. It features a Rukkus' remixed version of "Last Friday Night".

levels.name: RGB
levels.author: SleyGD
levels.desc: A solo 2.1 extreme demon made by SleyGD themed after the colors red, green, and blue. The level contains many different flashy background effects and a interesting mix of learny and skill-based gameplay. The level is notorious for its very laggy full detail mode and very difficult asymmetrical dual

levels.name: Loochiverse
levels.author: Nerhy
levels.desc: Made for the MatMart Civilization event with a bossfight against one of the creators (EpicLooch) made through image2gd, although he can't actually damage you. Got a nerfdate later on to make it more timing based and to fix the balancing issues while still keeping it predrop heavy.

levels.name: Jamboree
levels.author: JustJohn
levels.desc: Extremon which takes heavy inspiration from Spectrum Cyclone. Like its predecessor, it features learny asymmetrical dual gameplay and a very hard wave at the end.

levels.name: Freedom08
levels.author: Pennutoh
levels.desc: An intense four-minute megacollab featuring some very iconic names from early 2.1. It uses its iconic song to the maximum with very high-speed gameplay through the whole level. Its the first extreme to use Freedom Dive as a song, and has been remade in multiple different updates of the game.

levels.name: Altered Ascent
levels.author: Prism
levels.desc: A buffed and redecorated version of Artifical Ascent with altered, harder gameplay whilst nerfing the original chokepoints from its predecessor. Features a mysterious creator named Gs Craig in Michigun's part who still remains anonymous...

levels.name: Devil Vortex
levels.author: Rustam
levels.desc: A level that came from a denied part for Yatagarasu, which Rustam expanded on to make a full level. The decoration uses a hell theme with recognizable artworks. ToshDeluxe superbuffed and hack-verified the level, which later became one of the most infamous hacker exposals.

levels.name: DubKore X
levels.author: loogiah
levels.desc: A faithful remake of DubCore by MaJackO and Crack, which is one of the hardest 8* levels. This level follows the conventions of MaJackO’s “Core” series, featuring 1.9-style decoration and primarily slow paced gameplay.

levels.name: Collect All Pets
levels.author: Rynoxiouss
levels.desc: A design level by Rynoxious and Alrexx, named after the Roblox game of the same name. The gameplay is timing-based, without focusing on a specific gamemode.

levels.name: Ascension
levels.author: Kolros716
levels.desc: A four minute long rainbow level to the tune of Abracadavre from Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies. A passion project seven years in the making with detailed rainbow designs, interesting line art, and hard gameplay throughout. One of the rawest extremes in the game.

levels.name: The Fog
levels.author: Hechie
levels.desc: An atmospheric megacollab where the player traverses through ancient ruins whilst shrouded by dense fog. The gameplay is cube only and is heavily timing-based without using any spikes. levels.name: Time Extreme
levels.author: vortrox
levels.desc: The second part of Vortrox's superbuffed Robtop levels series. The level mainly follows the layout of Time Machine with much harder gameplay. Similarly to Stereo Extremeness, it also contains a difficult robot part in the second half.

levels.name: Echoes of Neon
levels.author: MinAY
levels.desc: A remake of Forsaken Neon and MinAY's proudest megacollab project. It has the original level's colour scheme, slope-oriented structures, large orb clusters and speed portals, while overhauling the decoration with modern tech-based designs and an extension which nearly doubles its length.

levels.name: Chromatic Haze
levels.author: Cirtrax
levels.desc: The official sequel to Prismatic Haze, containing even more hard waves, fast-paced and tighter gameplay, clicksync and an even longer and more nerve-racking ending than it's prequel. levels.name: Timor
levels.author: ColorBolt
levels.desc: A horror-themed level with gameplay by Colorbolt and decoration by Maxie25. It started as a top 1 layout which was later nerfed to a top 30 during its verification process. The gameplay is very brief and wave-focused.

levels.name: Celestial Force
levels.author: MindCap
levels.desc: A mid 2018 megacollab that mainly focuses on asymmetrical duals. The gameplay is incredibly learny and fast paced with the duals requiring complex timings and learning.

levels.name: OVERKILL
levels.author: Jinnans
levels.desc: An extreme made by Hawkyre and Jinnans, with the first half being entirely fast wave sections requiring excruciatingly demanding levels of consistency, and the second half serving as a laughably-easier "don't choke" section, containing a slow ship and end cube, and is as chokeable as it is flukeable

levels.name: Cadrega City
levels.author: Pennutoh
levels.desc: Extreme demon remake of Kurumi City that is also loosely inspired by Necropolis. levels.name: Ddiamond
levels.author: Lfritz
levels.desc: Colourful wave-based demon featuring Lfritz' trademark rainbow decoration and tight wave corridor gameplay similar to Diamond Blade, as well as some timings and ship gameplay.

levels.name: FIREPOWER
levels.author: Sillow
levels.desc: One of the longest nine circles extremes with a highly diverse skillset range. Gets gradually harder and faster paced as the level progresses, and feature

levels.name: The Mainframe
levels.author: notlsa
levels.desc: Notoriously learny memory level filled with creative gimmicks and gameplay tropes. Initially was inspired by the Ultimate Chicken Horse level of the same name.

levels.name: Video
levels.author: MaxxoRMeN
levels.desc: An 8 minute long level themed around MaxxoRMeN's experiences with internet addiction. levels.name: ConFusion
levels.author: DreamZoneGD
levels.desc: The second and easiest level of the ConTrilogy. Despite not being as fast as the original, this fusion laboratory still contains a hectic amount of movements. With the amount of flashing pulses and fakes featured, your learning experience may be too confusing to handle.

levels.name: Dole Damos
levels.author: Jeyzor
levels.desc: Quirky Jeyzor level known for its unique designs and fancy transitions. The gameplay is entirely made of duals besides one transition.

levels.name: Apollo 11
levels.author: nasgubb
levels.desc: The finale to Nasgubb's Space Trilogy that took over two years to create. A very long moon themed extreme with mostly simple consistency based gameplay, though it does feature a few memory/gimmicky sections. Known for being very stressful but enjoyable.

levels.name: Factory Realm X
levels.author: HelpegasuS
levels.desc: Very old 2.1 grayscale level featuring learny duals, a chokeable last swingcopter and a bossfight (with some inconsistent layering). Generally well-received despite its age.

levels.name: ZAPHKIEL
levels.author: Darwin
levels.desc: A former top level from early 2.1 notable for its extremely difficult wave parts, an iconic and climactic lava-themed section in the second half, and overall its awkward yet oddly satisfying gameplay. Initially hack-verified by Noctafly.

levels.name: Bete Noire
levels.author: ThePurgatory
levels.desc: The unofficial sequel to the Nine Circles level Fear Me, this extremon is space/electric themed and is very reminiscent of levels like Cosmic Cyclone. Has an endscreen which lasts over 30% of the level.

levels.name: lovel
levels.author: WireMuncher
levels.desc: Love themed memory & design level with a mostly hot pink colour scheme. The hardest part is the drop with an incredibly difficult mini wave dual. It was made for valentines day, but was a few days late with its release.

levels.name: Budding Roses
levels.author: Zeronium
levels.desc: A decently slow-paced megacollab hosted by Zeronium based on his old ship challenge "Vera Lynn." Because of this, the level has many hard ship parts, most notably the ship at 31%-42%, which is the same section of the song used within the original challenge.

levels.name: Digital Descent
levels.author: ViPriN
levels.desc: A former Top 1 which was originally easier than its predecessor until it got a buffdate. The decoration follows a similar theme to Artifical Ascent with 2.1 elements sprinkled throughout, and its difficulty notably spikes in the middle third of the level.

levels.name: Stalemate Redux
levels.author: GdTheTactiq
levels.desc: A remake of the insane demon Stalemate, which was falsely placed at #1 as the verifier insisted upon it being harder than Yatagarasu. The level features early 2.1 decoration, often dark and obscuring, with the 76–100% section being picked through a creator contest.

levels.name: Missing Benefits
levels.author: T G I
levels.desc: The first and only megacollaboration by Team Caliber, with gimmicky gameplay and dark, greyscale decoration. Known for the last 20%, which is significantly harder than the rest of the level.

levels.name: Omicron
levels.author: Team Proxima
levels.desc: Unofficial greek letter mega collab hosted by Team Proxima. Has a cool minigame at the end for a coin.

levels.name: Adelucid
levels.author: ArraegenGD
levels.desc: A gimmicky and fast-paced Extreme Demon utilizing Passable blocks, orb-based gameplay and uniquely ethereal decoration. Its a "true solo"  with the creator having finished the entire song, gameplay, decoration and verification by himself.

levels.name: Artificial Ascent
levels.author: ViPriN
levels.desc: An extremely popular former top 1 megacollab made in 2.0, initially hosted by LmAnubis and finished by Viprin. levels.name: Diamond Disco
levels.author: Zeronium
levels.desc: A pure solo extreme one year in the making, notable for its high-CPS clicksync gameplay, an incredibly mesmerising dual and its colour bass-complextro hybrid song. It focuses heavily on song representation, and uses editor particles, bright flashes, screen effects, complementary colours and player m

levels.name: Retention Rush
levels.author: TheBlackHell
levels.desc: Very purple memory extreme that mostly consists of fake structures, orbs and portals. The ending requires hitting certain coins after the "listen closely" text. Otherwise, you get geometrically dominated.

levels.name: Xronier
levels.author: zJinoBeats
levels.desc: A short, red and blue, pure solo extreme made and verified by now-music artist JinoBeats. Matching the song's chaotic, high-tempo energy its visuals are extremely flashy and its gameplay features many high-CPS bursts and is fast-paced all around. Very well-received amongst victors for getting extrem

levels.name: Crystal
levels.author: Zeronium
levels.desc: A solo extreme demon by Zeronium featuring a crystal cave theme. Its gameplay focuses on overall clicksync flowy gameplay with a slight emphasis on ship and wave. Contains a difficult last ship and has a very satisfying dash orb at 53%.

levels.name: Delta Interface
levels.author: Platnuu
levels.desc: The first installment of the Interface series. Has a lengthy predrop, followed by a difficult fast-paced drop, continued with a nerve-racking ending.  One of the first rated extreme demons to use a NONG, albeit the song has since been added to the GD Music Library.

levels.name: TURN THE LIGHTS OFF
levels.author: nikoberry
levels.desc: Zeronium CC entry that uses a Tally Hall song about puberty. The predrop and intermission are shrouded in darkness to match the name (someone turned the lights off). Said parts are also the hardest.

levels.name: Tempered Steel
levels.author: ItsHybrid
levels.desc: Originally an impossible top 1, which was later nerfed to top 50 after being hosted by ItsHybrid. It is the first level in the Metal trilogy. The decoration is themed around steel and heat, with a gray and yellow theme.

levels.name: Low Death
levels.author: KrmaL
levels.desc: A superbuffed remake of High Life by Migueword featuring KrmaL's signature unorthodox gameplay with difficult wave and ship sections. There are many easter eggs and ancient memes scattered around the level.

levels.name: Power Grid
levels.author: YraX
levels.desc: Fast-paced design extreme with a timings-based first half and a more memory-based second half. Originally was verified by Zeronium before being slightly nerfed and bugfixed by Lucidium.

levels.name: Killbot
levels.author: BoldStep
levels.desc: A memory level heavily inspired by the 1.9 level “Chaotic Machine.” The level is themed around a virus installing itself on the player's computer, visually obstructing the gameplay through flashes on the screen on top of a lot of fake routes. Also has an infamous UFO chokepoint at the end.

levels.name: Belloq
levels.author: Sminx
levels.desc: A desert-themed level based on Pennutoh’s “Spicy Layout #10.” The gameplay emphasizes clicksync, with decoration themed around Egyptian culture.

levels.name: Bass Cave
levels.author: bloodshot
levels.desc: This level was originally a hard demon, which then got superbuffed and hack-verified. The level later got another update and a legitimate verification by nSwish. Known for its chokepoint heavy gameplay and the goofy looking demon face at 14%.

levels.name: Night Rider
levels.author: LmAnubis
levels.desc: Legendary futuristic cyberpunk-themed XL extreme developed by some of the most distinguished community figures over the course of 5 years. levels.name: Dualies
levels.author: Gablor
levels.desc: 1-minute layout by Gablor which was decoed by multiple creators. Visually inspired from 2.0 levels and Plasma Pulse Finale. Features mirror portal gameplay in an unorthodox manner.

levels.name: Edelweiss
levels.author: hexitine
levels.desc: Ridiculously high CPS and fast-paced mountain themed extreme demon with super learny and middle-carried gameplay and a complex click pattern. levels.name: TheCinnyBun
levels.author: Cinny
levels.desc: A joke level Renn241 created for the player Cinny. The gameplay is made up of super fast flow gameplay and extremely difficult wave sections.

levels.name: Black Flag
levels.author: NEKONGAMES
levels.desc: Click-heavy pirate-themed level with an oddly long predrop and tricky muscle memory-based UFO sections. Known to be incredibly unoptimized and object dense. LDM may be required.

levels.name: The Hell Zone
levels.author: Stormfly
levels.desc: Former top 1 and first level in Sohn0924's hell series created back in 2014. It was later redecorated by Cyclic and TeamN2 members in 2016. levels.name: Neurostasis
levels.author: KiwiPenguin
levels.desc: The long standing former top 1 level on the enjoyments list. This level has gimmicky memory gameplay throughout, and most of it is in the ship gamemode with a lot of orbs.

levels.author: SrGuillester
levels.desc: Well known old level that was abandoned after one of its creators quit the game in 2016, but was revived and verified seemingly out of nowhere in 2020. levels.name: vaenstep
levels.author: vaen
levels.desc: A typical Renn241 extreme named after the player vaen, who verified and published the level. It is especially skill-based with the slow yet nerve-wracking 72% section being a main highlight. Its decoration uses a diverse colour palette and becomes a colourful mess during the drop despite the level's

levels.name: Stereo Extremeness
levels.author: vortrox
levels.desc: A popular superbuff of Stereo Madness with gameplay made by Vortrox. Was initially made for a youtube video and was later decorated following the layout's

levels.name: Glitched Memories
levels.author: TCTeam
levels.desc: A early 2.1 mega-collab semi-memory level that remixes many clubstep inspired levels. (ie Clubstep, Ice Carbon Diablo X, Tartarus, Red World, 9Step, and Clubstep Nightmares)

levels.name: Agony
levels.author: Vizitek
levels.desc: A Congregation-inspired solo extreme which, as the name suggests, is themed around agony with its bright flashes, flesh-like designs and an appropriately-chosen song. levels.name: SOLEIL
levels.author: luhlamar
levels.desc: Well received solo design-art-effect level centered around the sun, moon, and stars. Known to progressively get more difficult, and also have chokepoints in the break part at 44%.

levels.name: VIPER
levels.author: Joswhay
levels.desc: Green-themed glow-design megacollab named after the F-777 song it uses. The level features chokepoint-heavy flow gameplay including various short bursts of difficult wave inputs, with 78% being the most commonly criticized among victors.

levels.name: Ethereal Artifice
levels.author: zeroya
levels.desc: Generally well recieved 2.1 megacollab with a red and green color scheme. It's a fast-paced XL level spanning just over two minutes in length.

levels.name: The Moon Below
levels.author: Onvil
levels.desc: The first of two levels in the Beneath - Upward: Perfume EP by Onvil, preceding The Garden Above. levels.name: Death
levels.author: AleeXhey
levels.desc: A nine minute long emotionally powerful level that took over six years to complete. The first third is noticeably harder, but there is still tough gameplay very far into the level. A tribute to TSGuy, may he rest in peace.

levels.name: Magnificent Gaps
levels.author: JohnNwaogu
levels.desc: A magnificent remake of Impossible Gaps with a lot of finicky gimmicks and a short 2 player part. The level is fully ship gamemode with simple cute designs and visuals. The lord of chokepoints and raw skill gameplay, johnnwaogus magnificent masterpiece

levels.name: REDEEMER
levels.author: surveyor23
levels.desc: A 7 minute long extreme where giant humanoid spirits are released from their tombs, destroying the earth as they ascend. levels.name: Black Blizzard
levels.author: KrmaL
levels.desc: Former top 10 solo level by KrmaL. Initially this level was harder and being verified in secret, but after the level was leaked through a hack, KrmaL verified and released a nerfed version. This level got Creo well known within the community. The gameplay is gimmicky and extremely predrop carried.

levels.name: Astral Divinity
levels.author: Knobbelboy
levels.desc: One of Knobbelboy's most iconic and controversial solo levels. The gameplay is rather skill based, with very difficult ship and wave parts. Was relatively

levels.name: Lovestruck
levels.author: Tuna310
levels.desc: Love-themed sequel to Voltage featuring unconventional, heart filled decoration. Built among close friends including popular creators like Pocke, Loltad, & Shmigels. levels.name: Quantum Processing
levels.author: Riot
levels.desc: A superbuffed remake of the main level Blast Processing, with gameplay by Riot and Hinds and a short section by Zobros.

levels.name: BuTiTi III
levels.author: JonathanGD
levels.desc: Jonathan's nearly-cancelled threequel to his infamous Butiti series. The level is XL, featuring rainbow styled deco and a flashy and laggy pixelated background at the duals. levels.name: BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB
levels.author: MikeWheelerFan

levels.name: Polygonal Paradox
levels.author: Hypno
levels.desc: Black Blizzard inspired timing-based extreme utilizing complementary colors throughout, with a tricky dual in the second half. The gameplay is praised among victors despite being a relatively niche level.

levels.name: Funnyname Funnygame
levels.author: idleunam

levels.name: MUSKY MOLD
levels.author: wabug
levels.desc: Short and unsettling mold/swamp themed extreme, built by the creator while they were in a mental hospital. Has a unique cube-copter part and some extremely precise timings.

levels.name: SHOWDOWN
levels.author: berrytg
levels.desc: Flow megacollab using xKore - Showdown that is extremely reminiscent of Saul Goodman, even having the infamous upwards wave corridor at the end. As such, it is very learny with many moving objects and has many tough wave sections.

levels.name: I Cry
levels.author: GrenadeofTacos
levels.desc: The first level in Tacos' 1.9 GDPS Earth Circles series. Features unique Frutiger Aero decoration and includes a 'choose your path section' in the second half as well as a memory part.

levels.name: Hyper Paradox
levels.author: ItsHybrid
levels.desc: A nerfed remake of Hyper Paracosm featuring a modernized 2.1 style rather than raw Nine Circles decoration. levels.name: find the answer
levels.author: qalli
levels.desc: A solo extreme demon made by qalli, which uses a follow trigger setup to make unusual offset dual gameplay, along with other gimmicky gameplay throughout.

levels.name: Hatred
levels.author: AZuLer4
levels.desc: 2.0 demon made up of extremely difficult timing gameplay, an infamous ship gravity portal corridor at 70%, and to top it all off, a memory based mini cube section towards the end. Often draws comparisons to Acropolis due to its similar gameplay and theming.

levels.name: The Hell World
levels.author: Stormfly
levels.desc: A redecorated version of the former top 1 demon of the same name created by Sohn0924 back in 2014, the level is one of the last 2.0 extreme demons to be uploaded, with its rate causing the rate of Hate War and The Hell Zone. Updated due to enjoyability reasons by Stormfly in 2023.

levels.name: Static Ignition
levels.author: Magmeta
levels.desc: A solo remake of Electroman Adventures meant to rival Funnyman Adventures. Originally started as mid tier extreme for its time but was buffed in the decoration process. Received a small nerfdate in January of 2023 to nerf some of the highly controversial cube choke points.

levels.name: MISFIRE
levels.author: Galaxxyss
levels.desc: Pawsome furry themed extweme using an infamously difficult to listen to furry rap song because someone insulted Galaxxyss' music taste. levels.name: Necrocide
levels.author: Zylenox
levels.desc: Semi-forgotten extreme demon that went unrated for almost 7 years, which is also very memorable for its hyper-detailed factory style and surprising edginess for the time. levels.name: lodin da fish washer
levels.author: koko43
levels.desc: 🐟 A surreal modern style cube/robot timing level with very little spike usage. Features a unique and particularly hard timing (known locally as a 'fish washer') that is repeated multiple times, as well as lots more unusual timing gameplay. 🐟

levels.name: Glowy
levels.author: Rob Buck
levels.desc: A level with gameplay by Sunnett and decoration by Rob Buck. The decoration gradually becomes more object-heavy throughout the level, making it harder to see as the level goes on. The level was meant to mock other glow-heavy levels at the time.

levels.name: Rate Demon
levels.author: MikeWheelerFan
levels.desc: Early 2.1 recent tab themed joke extreme, with unorthodox decoration and many default blocks. The gameplay is entirely cube, robot, and ship, with a long robot part at the drop and an infamous last ship.

levels.name: MONSTROSITY
levels.author: Snarlax523
levels.desc: A level that was hack-verified, and as such has a lot of chokepoints, such as many parts in the pre-drop and the section around 42%. The gameplay is timing-based and gimmicky, with a repeated ship control section in the last 25%.

levels.name: Based Gang
levels.author: Alphirox
levels.desc: A 2-player level that takes inspiration from Bang Gang. In order to make it more feasible to beat it solo, the final 20% can be nerfed in exchange for not getting the coin.

levels.name: Bordon Factory
levels.author: Bordonn
levels.desc: Minimalistic factory themed level that uses gameplay to its fullest potential. Contains multiple gimmicky sections and a randomised bossfight.

levels.name: Auditory Breaker
levels.author: LazerBlitz
levels.desc: Nerfed remake of Sonic Wave made by Lazerblitz and Manix featuring early 2.1 tech style decoration.

levels.name: The Sulphur Sea
levels.author: YoReid
levels.desc: A very fast-paced, mini-only solo extreme themed around the Sulphurous Sea from Terraria's Calamity Mod, with a blocky visual style and progressing through the layers of the Abyss, ending off on a randomised bossfight against the Primordial Wyrm. levels.name: DESOLATE
levels.author: Billzer
levels.desc: Cube-based extreme themed around a stormy city. Somewhat gradually increases in intensity, but retains a dark and lonely atmosphere throughout.

levels.name: Crippled Depression
levels.author: NateFH
levels.desc: A buffed & decorated re-imagining of "Conical Depression" by KrmaL. At 50%, the level leads into a neon fast-paced ball part from then on to 85%, leading to a classic 1.

levels.name: Faded Dream
levels.author: DreamTide
levels.desc: Sequel to Endless Dream, created and verified solo, on mobile. Memorable for its atmosphere-focused visuals and climatic drop. Contains learny but very consistent gameplay and a difficult dual at 57%.

levels.name: Mujigae
levels.author: TheShadowRealm
levels.desc: Rainbow colored nine circles extreme which can be very hard on the eyes to some without the LDM. It features very difficult chokepoints, most notably the wave gap at 68%. One of two extremes to be featured on the account TheShadowRealm after its creator was exposed.

levels.name: Gateway
levels.author: WireMuncher
levels.desc: Solo extreme with unconventional but intuitive well-received gameplay. Surprisingly Eveteer's first finished level! Notable for its creative effects, good music representation and unique atmosphere.

levels.name: MadMansion
levels.author: GunnerBones
levels.desc: A remake of the 1.9 level MadHouse, with a grayscale color palette and subtle hints of other hues. Like the original, it is heavily memory-based and uses the same song.

levels.name: Khorne
levels.author: Stilluetto
levels.desc: Legendary extreme demon with a very rich history. The original version created by Hota1991 had around a million objects, the most out of any level of its time. levels.name: aether
levels.author: ZeroSR
levels.desc: Atmospheric design level known for being the first extreme to really go all out with 2.2 features. Contains simplistic monochrome decoration experimenting with gradient triggers and shaders, paired with fast-paced and gimmicky gameplay. Notably has a very scary wave at ~46%.

levels.name: Visurient
levels.author: fitatfi
levels.desc: Really old 2.1 level that was made for their friend Visurient. Took a few years to get rated.

levels.name: Voyager 1
levels.author: oliverbum
levels.desc: A 2.0 styled megacollab one year in the making, encapsulating a variety of decoration styles and gameplay tropes from that era. levels.name: Auroral Ascent
levels.author: rnexel
levels.desc: Well-received clicksync solo extreme aimed to be a more accessible level in Nexel's catalogue. Consists of a subdued color palette and an intense dual in the second half.

levels.name: Nostalgia
levels.author: iWarTey

levels.name: Io
levels.author: L4TeZk
levels.desc: Warm-toned 1.9 extreme loosely themed around the highly volcanically active moon Io. Hardest level in Latezk's moons-of-Jupiter series. Features a very gnarly dual at 80%.

levels.name: Worse Trip
levels.author: Loltad
levels.desc: Loltad level with very unique deco, paired with very unique (and fun) gameplay.

levels.name: Gentlemens Clique
levels.author: Alphirox
levels.desc: A 2-player level, a part of the gang trilogy. The level's name is meant to be a British version of Based Gang. Has a key you can collect to turn the bossfight icons into the Bass Cave demon.

levels.name: SubSonic
levels.author: ViPriN
levels.desc: The 4th official entry of the sonic series, and the hardest one. It was generally considered anticlimactic when it first came out, but nowadays it's gameplay is considered balanced and consistent throughout the entire level. Features an intimidating dual by Jeyzor at the ending.

levels.name: Dolos
levels.author: Enzeux
levels.desc: 2.1 click sync megacollab, known for its low CPS. Much of the level is a dual, and the ending is difficult and nerve-wracking. Named after the Greek god of deception.

levels.name: Endless Dream
levels.author: DreamTide
levels.desc: A well-received solo level made entirely and verified on mobile. Known for its simple yet pleasing designs, and for being quite enjoyable especially once you get past the learning process.

levels.name: EnvY
levels.author: Danzmen
levels.desc: DanZmeN level with a goated song, overall is extremely fun, but can feel frustrating due to balancing issues, with waves being the primary difficulty of the level. The ending is terrifying.

levels.name: Betrayal of Destiny
levels.author: Splash
levels.desc: A lesser-known 2.1 extreme based on WeoWeoTeo's Betrayal of Fate. Features skill based gameplay in the first half before transitioning to more memory based gameplay.

levels.name: Tunnel
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: An extremely large megacollab of 193 people, hosted by Akunakun, where each creator has a 3 block long part. The gameplay is corridor based.

levels.name: Loose Screws
levels.author: Aeyooo
levels.desc: Incredibly creative and unpolished extreme with alternative memory gameplay and extremely chaotic decoration, both of which inspired by Toxin Lab III. Features a difficult wave maze and an intimidating predrop. Despite its quirks, the gameplay is very highly regarded among victors!

levels.name: Cheyenne
levels.author: TheJosiahTurner
levels.desc: The sequel to the Insane Demon Apache, featuring blinding decoration with an extremely intense song. Started in 2018 and was reworked multiple times.

levels.name: Carmine Cascade
levels.author: AAAAAlex
levels.desc: Scarlet Surge remake with the signature deep red flashy pulses. Features much more memory heavy gameplay than the original, in AAAAAlex's signature style. Extremely well received despite technically being a superbuffed 7 star.

levels.name: UnveiL
levels.author: kr4t
levels.desc: Shiver me timbers, be that an XXL pirate themed megacollab! Yahar matey! (full creator list will be added soon)

levels.name: ErebuS
levels.author: Platnuu
levels.desc: Nerfed and redecorated remake of Erebus made by Platnuu. This level leans into a more biohazard and toxic style theme instead of the generic green theming that the original has. The gameplay is pretty much the same as Erebus except it's easier, but it notably lacks the iconic last click of the origi

levels.name: milo
levels.author: xSlendy
levels.desc: A Classic styled xSlendy level seemingly inspired by Saul Goodman. Startpos: 120275555

levels.name: Carnage Mode
levels.author: Findexi
levels.desc: Early 2.1 timing and nerve control level notable due to numerous chokepoints throughout the level, most noteworthy being the 'pants-shittingly' difficult ending segment by Lemons.

levels.name: miss you
levels.author: shmigels
levels.desc: Shmigels solo level featuring intentionally wacky gameplay. Has an infamous last ship, and the asymmetrical dual is featured in BarbarosFinaleFinale with added camera effects.

levels.name: RASH
levels.author: Loltad
levels.desc: Solo extreme themed around diseased and decomposing flesh, with fast paced and generally well received gameplay, and strong music representation. Most notably has a very confusing and unusually structured timing based predrop. The previous description was way too funny so I'm leaving it in: "Loltad

levels.name: Voltage
levels.author: Hypno
levels.desc: Contrary to ThePurgatory's "Voltage," Hypno's memory megacollab consists of incredibly unique gameplay and visuals. Specifically, it combines traditional design with extremely unorthodox symmetrical-ish gameplay and structuring, making for a particularly learny and satisfying experience.

levels.name: Wild Rose
levels.author: Galaxxyss
levels.desc: Vibrant flower-themed design level dedicated to the musician and VTuber Mori Calliope. It features a strong contrast where its slow-paced and tranquil build-up breaks into a flowy and dazzling fast-paced drop lasting until the end.

levels.name: kuiper belt
levels.author: Nordgeez
levels.desc: A 2.2 remake of the wave-only level Kuiper by Quasar and TMNGaming. Made to be as faithful to the original as possible, down to even the balancing. Has a high CPS part at 50% that may be difficult for some.

levels.name: Ithacropolis
levels.author: BIGMAC77
levels.desc: Purple Necropolis remake with a city theme throughout that was made during the transition between 2.0 and 2.1. levels.name: Athanatos
levels.author: IIExenityII
levels.desc: Hack-verified level from 2016 which includes very difficult wave chokepoints, including an infamously difficult dual wave at 70%. It is one of the many hell-themed top 1s, surpassing Sakupen Hell when it was placed.

levels.name: Cryothorn Hell
levels.author: TornadoMan616
levels.desc: An  ice-themed remaster of Sakupen Hell, containing the same gameplay with some alterations, including the addition of a difficult wave extension and a chokable cube section near the end.

levels.name: Le Midd Mapperoonies
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: A three minute long non stop memory level. Gets gradually harder as the level progresses, with a very hard wave near the end. Received a balance update in late 2024 which both buffed the first half and nerfed the second half, easing the difficulty increase through the level.

levels.name: WcropoliX
levels.author: BlassCFB
levels.desc: Known for being a robbed top 1 and taking nearly 9 years to finally get rated. Infamous for its wave at around halfway through the level.

levels.name: TeaM Z
levels.author: 99percent
levels.desc: Early 2.1 design Extreme Demon famous for having an incorrectly layered "bossfight" by Xyriak. Supposedly the final level in a series. It is also notorious for having unconventional gameplay.

levels.name: Masterpiece
levels.author: vRidge
levels.desc: An open ended solo level that is intended to run alongside vRidge's other extreme To The Blue Moon.

levels.name: dance
levels.author: MysteryMaan
levels.desc: Solo created and verified 2-player level made for Lia's and Gecko's 2P Creator Contest, using a song from a Persona 4 spin-off game. The gameplay is entirely clicksync and very learny. The drop, from 33%-42%, is by far the hardest part.

levels.name: S3NT1M3NT
levels.author: shynethecreator
levels.desc: A short and fast paced ATOMIC CANNON inspired solo level by AREDL list leader Shyne! Features names of many AREDL members throughout, a horizontal spider orb, and has an infamously hard wave near the end. Has become a large insider meme in AREDL, and additionally took 6 months and 33 opinions to pla

levels.name: Poltergeist Reborn
levels.author: ThePrimeEvil
levels.desc: 2.1 remake of Andromeda's infamous insane demon. While generally better received than the original, this level remains quite chokepoint heavy. Also features a short extension with a tough memory last wave.

levels.name: reset your mind
levels.author: fursona
levels.desc: Glitchy & hyper-dense solo 1.9 styled level about what the level's name suggests. Memorable for its fun, unconventional memory gameplay and claustrophobic structuring that might appear as object spam at first.

levels.name: Supreme Demon Mix
levels.author: TwisterDude161
levels.desc: A reimagining of Zobros' "Ultimate Demon Mix", often containing fast-paced gameplay requiring a variety of skillsets. Each part of the level is styled after one of 23 different demons.

levels.name: Hyperliminal
levels.author: Andromity
levels.desc: Vibrant solo extreme making good use of shaders and 2.2 triggers. Consists of bright flashes, unique designs and complex color schemes. With an enjoyment rating of over 90, the 12 playtesters clearly did their job well!

levels.name: AUTONOMICA
levels.author: xTet
levels.desc: Solo XXL greyscale level themed around exploring a mechanical city, and utilising a vocaloid song to good effect. The gameplay incorporates a lot of moving objects, and has a dual heavy second half

levels.name: OneAttempt
levels.author: TheRealXFuture
levels.desc: A fast-paced level themed around OneShot, containing sections that represent the original areas of the game. Features timings in various gamemodes throughout the level, as well as a choice on how the level ends likewise to the source material and an alternate ending/coin route through using practice

levels.name: Kinetic Bypass
levels.author: Sminx
levels.desc: Kinetic Bypass is a fast, skill-based 2.1 design level by Sminx and verified by Luqualizer. Despite its shorter length, it uses a wide variety of gameplay styles; featuring a slow predrop, wave, robot, a long dual, and flow gameplay.

levels.name: Treatment Facility
levels.author: MMANH
levels.desc: 1.9 styled design level inspired by Toxic Sewers, themed around escaping an underground wastewater facility. Includes lots of subtle effects and movements to build immersion. References the infamous Rupture wave at 40%.

levels.name: New Record
levels.author: lTemp
levels.desc: A highly click-sync based megacollab. While the gameplay aligns with the music, its gimmicky nature still requires memorization and practice. The decoration is colorful and energetic, reflecting the fast-paced song. The layout showcase, "highscore w/ clicks", managed to get over 3M views.

levels.name: project girlboss
levels.author: koko43
levels.desc: The self-described "most confusing level" in the game, and it's pretty easy to see why. Made by Koko43, this level contains some of the most unconventional (albeit satisfying) gameplay out of any level, with the dual spider section in the final third being particularly unorthodox. The level has a bl

levels.name: Infernal Abyss
levels.author: Ggb0y
levels.desc: Forgotten sequel to Cataclysm. Hack verified like its predecessor. Infamous for a really difficult UFO at 65%, and a difficult coin at the last ship.

levels.name: Nautilus
levels.author: Tabgnid
levels.desc: Tabgnid's first solo level, a 1.9-style extreme with flow gameplay inspired by Prismatic Haze.

levels.name: shattered lens
levels.author: XDjoa
levels.desc: A collab between XDjoa and SoggyDash for the Zeronium CC2! Features stinking greyscale effects and fast paced, dual heavy gameplay throughout.

levels.name: hot rod
levels.author: stcubing
levels.desc: stcubing's first megacollab, birthed from a Cognition/Oblivion spinoff layout created out of spite for Carcano. It features bright colours and decoration with an upbeat song, and is one of the more accessible levels of this genre.

levels.name: Vertigo
levels.author: notLevo
levels.desc: An early 2.1 extreme demon that took 8 years to be rated. The gameplay has scattered chokepoints, with the middle of the level being much harder than the rest of the level.

levels.name: Phobos
levels.author: KrmaL
levels.desc: 1.9/2.0 megacollab that was initially hack-verified in a much harder state, but was reverified in an easier form by KrmaL. The level doesn't have a very high enjoyment, and contains a lot of difficulty spikes.

levels.name: Summer Sky
levels.author: Luvery
levels.desc: Extremely well-polished XL sky themed extreme memorable for its clean, glass-like block designs and very very well-received clicksync gameplay. Notably uses a special time warp trigger mechanic to keep sync as consistent and quality as possible.

levels.name: Removed Submission
levels.author: WHErwin
levels.desc: Newgrounds-themed level with a gray and orange color scheme, and uses elements of the site such as bits of text, a big angry emoji, and tankmen to compliment the Newgrounds style. Known for its iconic song which disses BrokenDeck, and the drop parts using unique spider timings.

levels.name: Glacial Torrent
levels.author: Nelll
levels.desc: Early 2.1 XXL ice-themed megacollab completely created and verified by mobile players. Generally pretty incohesive but charming visually, with part quality varying very significantly throughout. Its gameplay is high-cps and mildly janky, reflecting its time period pretty well.

levels.name: Wayback Array
levels.author: royen
levels.desc: Fast, upbeat and fun megacollab started 'way back' in 2019. Took 4 years to complete and another 2 years to get rated.

levels.name: help
levels.author: llertt
levels.desc: A-

levels.name: Coolie Mazie Paloozi
levels.author: Akunakunn
levels.desc: Dense & colorful memory "insane demon" created by the feared memory creator Akunakun and verified by the beloved youtuber Tride. Includes 12 large, distinct, and extremely confusing mazes.

levels.name: water demon
levels.author: hexitine
levels.desc: Very complex hexitine level that plays like a puzzle, and includes a difficult mirror section in the middle. The structuring and effects are unique and well-made, but the level is generally poorly received. Contains invisible hitboxes.

levels.name: Grind District
levels.author: Airz
levels.desc: A 1.9 style memory extreme made by Airz while they were working on Skeletal Shenanigans. Features a very difficult second half.

levels.name: Falcon16
levels.author: LIEB
levels.desc: 2.1 megacollab hosted by LIEB with a prevalent sky theme throughout, infamous for Tob's steampunk themed part and the tight waves at the beginning of the drop. Despite being considered quite first-half heavy and having several blind clicks, it's still received positively by its victors

levels.name: Blade of Justice
levels.author: Manix648
levels.desc: An extremely high quality 2.0 level by two of the most talented creators at the time. Features multiple iconic parts such as the black hole UFO and asymmetrical dual, and is generally harder at the start and end. Formerly an upcoming top 1 before receiving a large nerfdate making it more accessible

levels.name: Astrophobia
levels.author: Jakalope
levels.desc: 1.9gdps nine circles extreme demon collab made by Jakalope, royen, and valentine that focuses on detail and intense nine circles effects reflecting the song. The gameplay and design is generally praised by most people who've played it.

levels.name: Sakupen Hell
levels.author: TrusTa
levels.desc: Famous for being the level to take the #1 spot away from Bloodbath. Known to be very imbalanced, with the majority of the difficulty coming from the waves. It's also the shortest former top 1 in terms of level length, with the gameplay lasting under 50 seconds.

levels.name: ACHROMATISM
levels.author: CirclezGD
levels.desc: 2.2 Prismatic Haze remake that also doubles as the first Turkish solo extreme demon ever!

levels.name: Bang Gang
levels.author: Danzmen
levels.desc: The first 2-player extreme in Geometry Dash. Was verified by four different people swapping positions mid-completion. The decoration is in DanZmeN's typicial 2019 style. Features learny segments and a bossfight with arrows that are not entirely accurate.

levels.name: Advent Aurora
levels.author: Ultimxte
levels.desc: The last Extreme Demon uploaded in 2.1; A colorful, glowy, and vaguely aurora-themed level, described by the creator as a "floating world under the moonlight."

levels.name: THE PRINCE
levels.author: JustWaaf
levels.desc: Repetition-based memory extreme using a Madeon song and only cube, robot and ball for its gamemodes. It's reminiscent of the Sunset Sandstorm predrop, with deviations between the same repeated pattern to match the song. The 2nd half is a nerve wracking ball section that is very chokable.

levels.name: Delicious Dogs
levels.author: SupaCLUCK
levels.desc: A megacollab themed around early 2.1 levels, containing stereotypical decoration and gameplay elements inspired by its reference time period. It took nearly a year for the level to finally get rated.

levels.name: Infinite Inversion
levels.author: Filqh
levels.desc: Significantly easier predecessor to Axiom Asterism, featuring electric purple space-themed visuals and fast-paced circles gameplay. Interestingly, the predrop uses only blue pads, orbs & gravity portals.

levels.name: EXPLICIT
levels.author: waturn
levels.desc: A short, extremely fast-paced level made up of highly compressed difficulty in its total runtime of 41 seconds. Has very tight wave parts that require precise control, as well as generally high CPS gameplay chockfull with timings galore.

levels.name: Twilight Coexistence
levels.author: NesiaL
levels.desc: Relatively unknown Korean duo level notable for its extremely fast-paced dual gameplay. Contains neo-design adjacent decoration with an inconsistent pink and blue palette.

levels.name: The Old Trail
levels.author: Bram4Real
levels.desc: Solo intended XL 2p level by Bram4Real, inspired by his own experience in trail hiking. The level has hard timing gameplay for the predrop and drop, and then turns into a 2p dual for the rest.

levels.name: maddening
levels.author: shmigels
levels.desc: geometry dash map that shmigels created using the level editor

levels.name: SUPERCONDUCTOR
levels.author: At242
levels.desc: Extremely high cps solo level by At424. The spider and wave are very high cps, demanding a lot of stamina.

levels.name: CLOWNS
levels.author: Avanna
levels.desc: Bright and colourful circus themed solo extreme that took 2 years to get rated.

levels.name: Carcano
levels.author: Asuith
levels.desc: A popular Cognition-style corridor level built by two Polish creators, with high CPS and timing-based gameplay. Despite receiving a nerfdate in early 2022, community opinions are still quite mixed, which wasn't helped by the slope interaction changes in 2.2.

levels.name: Ecstasy
levels.author: SleyGD
levels.desc: Very flashy solo extreme you'll regret opening the editor on due to the sheer amount of triggers. The difficulty features varied gameplay, with a dual lasting from 65 all the way to the end giving it an easy but chokeable ending.

levels.name: Betrayal of Fate
levels.author: weoweoteo
levels.desc: A somewhat lesser known 2.0 extreme with skill based gameplay in the first half, which features a relatively difficult mini ball and dual wave section. The second half introduces memory sections including a cube maze that turns invisible towards the end.

levels.name: Fusion Z
levels.author: PlebKIngdom
levels.desc: The final installment in the Fusion series. An extremely long and intense level with well rounded but stressful gameplay. Has a very long, complex, and controversial history.

levels.name: Blue Suns Zenith
levels.author: IceboxOG
levels.desc: Incredibly creative extreme inspired by Magic The Gathering, using Blue Zenith by xi as its song. Memorable for its difficult sideways wave among other unique gameplay gimmicks. Glory to Phyrexia

levels.name: Revolution 1993
levels.author: Bemq
levels.desc: Solo XXL+ extreme to the tune of Revolution 1993 by Jamiroquai. Features many dual sections over its 10 minute runtime. Come on, fight the power!

levels.name: OPSM1
levels.author: autechregd
levels.desc: A VARSE level with bright and modern decoration. A good majority of the difficulty comes from the wave sections in the first half, with other small chokepoints scattered throughout the level.

levels.name: Inside
levels.author: Hypno
levels.desc: Hypno's second solo Extreme Demon project, inspired by the rhythm game Sayonara Wild Hearts. It showcases Hypno's signature gameplay style: learny yet intuitive, focused on unique structuring. Noteworthy for its difficult duals, exceptional song representation and simplistic neon designs.

levels.name: Silentium Gradas
levels.author: Stormfly
levels.desc: A Stormfly megacollab remake of Silent clubstep, containing almost identical gameplay, albeit heavily nerfed.

levels.name: Project Nexus
levels.author: NEKONGAMES
levels.desc: The official sequel to the list extreme Jigsaw, featuring similarly flowy gameplay and polished tech-themed designs. Originally was gonna be verified by Nexus, but it was passed to LordVaderCraft instead. Generally flew under the radar significantly more than its predecessor.

levels.name: Techno Disco
levels.author: M4th3oGames
levels.desc: Sequel of Techno Flashes that uses the same song. Upgrades the its predecessors decoration by incorporating more complex neon designs and by increasing the energy. The second half features a rainbow color palette and the Flashback Zone™ incase you forgot its a sequel to Techno Flashes.

levels.name: Ergonomic Chair
levels.author: BLOEM
levels.desc: A chair designed for efficiency and comfort. (Purple and yellow extreme mainly featuring ship and wave gameplay, but also features a swing dual and a multi-creator triple trial at the end.)

levels.name: Absolute Solver
levels.author: DimaBrozzy3
levels.desc: Murder Drones themed level with a nightcore-metal song from the final episode. Involves numerous references from the show and many flashy, tech themed effects. Although incredibly learny, the gameplay is highly praised.

levels.name: GewErbiX
levels.author: Wintter
levels.desc: A bright and colourful flow level with a lot of orb focused gameplay.

levels.name: Paranoid Android
levels.author: Alass
levels.desc: A 5 and a half minute level to the tune of the Radiohead song of the same name. It takes on a very progression-based approach to represent its song - the level spends its first half building up to its climax with fast-paced gameplay and flashy visuals before ending off on a much slower 2 minute-long

levels.name: overlook
levels.author: androgyny
levels.desc: An extremely atmospheric timing-focused extreme with it's decoration inspired by the game Rain World, where also, there's no music at all. It's gameplay is considered unbalanced since it contains in the first two thirds a slow-paced ball and cube with very low CPS and tight timings, while the last t

levels.name: Azure Fiesta
levels.author: Dorami
levels.desc: Prequel to Snowfall Fiesta. The level features a summer-like song with somewhat inconsistent decoration.

levels.name: Game Over
levels.author: SrGuillester
levels.desc: A very unorthodox level featuring an abundance of difficult timings in the first section, becoming a high-CPS wave consistency challenge in the second section that tests the player's stamina and spam skill.

levels.name: PROTOFLICKER
levels.author: ewop
levels.desc: An extreme demon collab with a sparkly & glowy effect style throughout. Has a few memory parts and mostly clicksync gameplay scattered around the second half. Received a nerf-date especially for the first wave section.

levels.name: OUTPUT SPRING
levels.author: TheRealXFuture
levels.desc: A generally well-received 2.2 Lit Fuse-esque extreme demon themed around the aesthetics of computation, featuring a range of gimmick and clicksync gameplay. The coin requires you to read mock code in order to understand how to obtain it.

levels.name: GO bird
levels.author: awesomeme360
levels.desc: A long invisible level that follows a group of birds through a forest as the days pass by. The gameplay consist of mostly clicksync timings with some high cps parts present at the drops. Features visual indicators such as trigger orbs to guide the player in some parts.

levels.name: moment
levels.author: lexycat
levels.desc: Highly popular and well received flowy extreme with a simplistic yet pleasing design. Very chokeable, particularly in the wave sections. Features an immediate ship click at the start.

levels.name: burn to dust
levels.author: crazyllama
levels.desc: Chaotic design styled learny level with unconventional and super fast paced gameplay. Features very unorthodox structuring and an endscreen where you avoid the text.

levels.name: Siniristi
levels.author: Leksitoo
levels.desc: XXL hypercollab made to celebrate Finland's 100th birthday! Named after the Finnish flag (Blue Cross), it shares its blue and white colour scheme and features many cultural references throughout its runtime. Was one of the largest megacollabs in the game when rated.

levels.name: Fever Dream
levels.author: ElirpscalionPC
levels.desc: Unique design extreme created and verified solo, gradually becoming messier and more dreamlike. Contains high-cps gameplay and difficult straight fly sections.

levels.name: same old
levels.author: WireMuncher
levels.desc: Simple & effective design extreme with a distinct RGBY color scheme. Has many repetitive memory sections that pair well with the song, and also has a highly chaotic QuazeryIceCube style maze at the end with hundreds of possible routes.

levels.name: Bloodbath
levels.author: Riot
levels.desc: One of the most popular extreme demons in the game, and the second level of the Apocalyptic trilogy. This level was known for being the hardest of its time, due to the ship parts being near impossible at the time. Nowadays a pretty tough level, with Michigun's part being arguably the most difficult.

levels.name: Untitled
levels.author: iiLuna
levels.desc: Turqoise and cyan colored level with somewhat high cps sync gameplay. The main difficulty comes from the drop. Resembles one of the 'reta' levels to some extent.

levels.name: Carbon Fiber
levels.author: xSlendy
levels.desc: Speedy grey & yellow design solo with very high-cps gameplay, clocking in at only 50 seconds long. Contains very difficult wave bursts paired with flowy timings. Notably suffered from a "horrendous case of forced difficulty" before it was re-playtested and verified, allowing it to become pretty well

levels.name: Omorfia
levels.author: HHyper
levels.desc: Effect layout by HHyper, with an iconic bossfight at the end. The gameplay is gimmicky and learny.

levels.name: Motorbreath
levels.author: TwisterDude161
levels.desc: Colorful skill-based extreme using a Metallica song with very high-cps clicksync gameplay. Contains a difficult predrop and an intimidating cube maze at 84%.

levels.name: gravity
levels.author: KazaGD
levels.desc: Official sequel to Moment, arguably improving on the original. Incorporates a green and pink color scheme while retaining a difficulty very similar to its predecessor. Notably was verified in 2021 and rated in late 2025.

levels.name: Callisto
levels.author: L4TeZk
levels.desc: 1.9 style extreme memorable for its incredibly satisfying and well-received gameplay. One of the four levels by Latezk named after Jupiter's four largest moons.

levels.name: Blueprint
levels.author: Waterbound
levels.desc: Another Waterbound solo that now utilizes more gimmicks like the Beach Ball and the Shwave. It includes a randomized Minesweeper pattern at the end that you have to solve in order to hit the right toggle orb at the end. Also has one of the most evil last clicks in any extreme demon in this range.

levels.name: Prismatic Haze
levels.author: Cirtrax
levels.desc: An extremely well known and influential clicksync wave/timing level. Has some very narrow but well synced wave parts, and a slow but very hard ending. Beware of the fish...

levels.name: EKO
levels.author: PureDinoMight
levels.desc: Faithful Acu spinoff that is almost twice the length of the original. Features many of the same gameplay quirks found in Acu, similar modern deco, and a very hard ending.

levels.name: Barbaros Finale
levels.author: Moffe
levels.desc: A pirate themed level with very raw gameplay and a bossfight at the end. Has a generally mixed reception due to the nature of its gameplay along with some transparent objects near the end.

levels.name: OUCH
levels.author: awesomeme360
levels.desc: Fire themed megacollab with a variety of well known creators, using a buffed Shmigels layout. This level also has randomised memory gimmick where a number at 28% tells you how many times to jump at 33%.

levels.name: Chromatic
levels.author: orangutanggg
levels.desc: The official sequel to Prismatic by CatGeo made by a different creator. The gameplay differs with its faster gameplay and difficult ship parts. The decoration has much more variation in it including a complete tone shift at 64%. The level makes several references to poocubed, another level that uses

levels.name: Dyad
levels.author: awesomeme360
levels.desc: A solo XXL extreme where you race your friend to the moon! Created for the Zeronium creator contest, this level features four contrasting sections, repetitive sync gameplay, and a lot of character and personality.

levels.name: Cluttered Confusion
levels.author: Enfur
levels.desc: Sequel to "Miscellaneous Memory" by the same creator, being much more polished and well-decorated. The gameplay is incredibly learny yet consistent with a pretty hard last dual. Refer to the creator's tutorial video for easier learning.

levels.name: Triple Six
levels.author: Zylenox
levels.desc: A truly hell-themed memory extreme with artistic yet gory designs. Consists of a flashy 2nd drop with heavy usage of teleportals, and an orbless mini cube maze with ship and wave sections in between.

levels.name: Conical Depression
levels.author: KrmaL
levels.desc: Originally made as a joke by KrmaL in 2.0 and rated due to a bet with RobTop over the verification, this level is entirely decorated with 1.0 blocks and is extremely imbalanced. What did you expect?

levels.name: Disentombed
levels.author: YakobNugget
levels.desc: Sequel to YakobNugget's previous megacollab Unearthed, containing similarly glowy decoration themed around exploring an underground tomb. Recieved a balance update 2 years after release, and is generally decently aged and well-received.

levels.name: Tron
levels.author: FunnyGame
levels.desc: The first Extreme Demon made by the legendary creator FunnyGame, themed around the sci-fi series of the same name. The gameplay is often considered to be of poor quality, and the level contains a long cutscene at the beginning.

levels.name: Heavens Door
levels.author: TMco
levels.desc: TMco collab themed around the I Wanna Be The Guy needle games. Mostly black and white with small amounts of rainbow coloration and a heaven theme. The gameplay is very learny and increases in intensity throughout the level.

levels.name: Idols
levels.author: Zafkiel7
levels.desc: A megacollaboration by 21 creators serving as a mini-tribute to 1.9, featuring multiple callbacks to older levels. The level is fast-paced with glow-style decoration, and is nearly 4 minutes long.

levels.name: Down Bass
levels.author: Spectruh
levels.desc: Originally an easier Nine Circles level created in 1.9. Went through a number of different versions and updates throughout 2.0 until it was superbuffed. Seen as rather unpopular due to the buffs made and less-than-desirable appearance. Has some serious chokepoints throughout the wave.

levels.name: Frozen
levels.author: RatQuesadilla
levels.desc: A very chill and icy themed extreme demon that contains disorienting effects at 69% which can make a bit difficult to read. The gameplay is full based on weird timings, such as orbs with slopes at start, a ton of double clicks at the drop and dash orbs pauses mid air.

levels.name: Distortion
levels.author: iamfinley
levels.desc: Colorful maymory memory map created by finley and friends.

levels.name: 6LACKLIGHT
levels.author: mbynot
levels.desc: *Epilepsy Warning*

levels.name: INNARDS
levels.author: Kaito
levels.desc: Grayscale with red level, with a lot of blood details. This was initially a nearly-impossible top 1, before being extremely nerfed. While everything's mostly balanced, the wave sections can be quite the difficulty spikes.

levels.name: Revelations
levels.author: vRidge
levels.desc: A loose mashup of all of vRidges levels. Decorated with a solid design style and utilizing minimal effects. Pair upped with fast paced clicksync and wave burst gameplay. Containing meaningful text scattered around the level.

levels.name: A Bizarre Phantasm
levels.author: TeamN2
levels.desc: A classic 2.0 level with challenging, diverse gameplay and icy blue theming. Has an infamous memory part near the end requiring the player to collect 21 keys in a specific order.

levels.name: ETERNAL
levels.author: ivyteal

levels.desc: Deceptively simple beginning until the difficulty spikes in the second half. Nerve wracking as a result.

levels.desc: Easy extreme demon most notable for the extremely hard wave in the mid points. The rest of the level is considerably easier except for a few hard ship gaps.

levels.name: Doop

levels.author: TheRealShun
levels.desc: Strange, poorly received modern extreme from 2020 that has been described as a superbuffed 4 star.

levels.desc: Solo extreme with light gradient decoration reminiscent of Rust. Has mainly timing based gameplay, and a ship at the end with a lot of orbs.

levels.author: culobdj
levels.desc: Very pink level built as the creator's first finished deco project, a level where you must party without being caught by the eyeball police. Contains many different kinds of gameplay and is generally well received.

levels.name: UltraSans
levels.author: PlebKIngdom

levels.name: Bored Walk

levels.name: Jail Break
levels.author: RadScorpionGD
levels.desc: Solo extreme with over 200 hours of editor work where you break out of prison and traverse through forests and cityscapes as you attempt to escape the police. Its gameplay is full of gamemode switches and has a few camera gimmicks, and the deco has many easter eggs.

levels.name: Stasis
levels.author: ArraegenGD
levels.desc: Arraegen's entry in the Zeronium CC2 Creator Contest! Uses player colors for the colors of the decoration.

levels.name: STARBREAKER
levels.author: ClingingBog
levels.desc: The prequel to STARCRASH with gameplay made by SoggyCat and decorated by ClingingBog. Set in an abandoned city, where a star creation experiment is left unmaintained. levels.name: ROW
levels.author: ewop

levels.name: Paranoid
levels.author: Deppied

levels.author: SleyGD

levels.name: Steel Terrors
levels.author: DreamZoneGD

levels.name: Existentia
levels.author: namirashik
levels.desc: "sorry for gameplay lol"

levels.name: YIPPEE
levels.author: Enfur
levels.desc: Enfur's first 2.2 level which uses a rainbow theme and is much more accessible than their other levels. YIPPEE!!!

levels.name: Reanimate
levels.author: ilnm

levels.name: My Own Funeral
levels.author: sayonarofc
levels.desc: A red effect solo extreme with an unsettling atmosphere. Contains a short memory section in the second half.

levels.name: Explosion
levels.author: EternaswipVMAX
levels.desc: A remake of Lit Fuse, in which the gameplay and decoration are practically identical to its predecessor. With the first half being much harder, this could be considered one of the most nerve-wracking entry extremes.

levels.name: On1y Cub3
levels.author: DrCuber
levels.desc: Solo level by DrCuber. As the name implies, this level is purely cube gameplay with various timing gimmicks. Has a notoriously hard first part, and two parts with an orb that follows the player.

levels.author: Polarbeahr
levels.desc: A level inspired by volume and made as an attribute to Metalface. Boost a couple similarities to Volume, most notably having a pretty difficult wave section in the middle of the level.

levels.name: Castling
levels.author: Meroo

levels.name: Shotgun
levels.author: SpinStudios
levels.desc: An extreme demon by the large creation team SpinStudios, which gives it a very varying glow decoration style emphasising effects and design with a mostly red and orange color scheme. Contains flowy and fast paced gameplay with difficult wave sections.

levels.name: A Fleeting Reverie

levels.name: Elite Z Rebirth
levels.author: KrmaL
levels.desc: Remake of the old impossible level Elite Z. Primarily known for the infamous two-player straight fly and the "So Pro?" UFO spam.

levels.name: Freedom16

levels.name: four

levels.name: Cybersonic
levels.author: MinAY

levels.name: Duplication
levels.author: Zeptoz

levels.author: JonathanGD

levels.name: Melancholy
levels.author: Shulkern
levels.desc: Dark and emotional XXL+ solo level with minimalistic but effective decoration. Nearly entirely greyscale, but gains a small but meaningful amount of colour at the second drop. levels.name: Me Lin A
levels.author: n1ckxd
levels.desc: A sequel to insane demon Lin Anya. Features mostly all-around learny gameplay, though the ship is more prominent than the other gamemodes. The level mixes design, art and effect decoration with its vibrant and colorful glow style.

levels.name: Obscura
levels.author: Eridani

levels.name: XtC
levels.author: jbooster

levels.name: Color Beam
levels.author: Bizaare
levels.desc: Bizaare's ode to the simpler side of Geometry Dash. An xl memory level using deliberately simple designs and subtle effects, and prioritising song representation above all else.

levels.name: Cerebral Torment
levels.author: SirPotatOwO
levels.desc: A solo extreme demon that has very bizarre, unconventional yet intriguing art decoration attached with a heavy amount of variety. The gameplay matches this decoration style by being heavily unorthodox.

levels.name: Polish Alphabet
levels.author: AxolotlCamellia

levels.name: MELTDOWN
levels.author: Darwin

levels.name: Artificial Climb
levels.author: Rynoxiouss
levels.desc: A red and gray-colored beginner megacollab extreme that captures the style of old 2.0 levels with both its decoration being influenced by Artificial Ideology, and its unconventional gameplay style. The gameplay itself is all-around, though the wave parts are slightly more difficult.

levels.name: STRATUS
levels.author: Woom

levels.name: Alcatraz
levels.author: Asuith

levels.name: Liz
levels.author: issanagay

levels.name: The Depths Above
levels.author: Bram4Real

levels.name: Cataclysm
levels.author: Ggb0y
levels.desc: One of the most well known extreme demons. The first level in the Apocalyptic trilogy. Consists of a lot of difficult ship parts and an extremely hard beginning wave.

levels.name: Forbidden Isle
levels.author: Sillow
levels.desc: Sillow extreme demon which, like their others, consists of mostly skill based gameplay, mostly wave and ship.

levels.name: Twitch Denan
levels.author: Kapycta999
levels.desc: An extreme with a theming around the streaming platform which is featured in its pre-drop and ending; it otherwise features purple-colored glow decoration. Contains flowy and learny gameplay with the wave parts being most prevalent in difficulty.

levels.name: Ion
levels.author: shmigels
levels.desc: A 1.6 styled level started in early 2.1 and finished in 2.2. Known for being one of the best ship based beginner extremes. Has an asymmetrical dual in the middle and a hard Electrodynamix / 8o style ending ship.

levels.name: Virtual Collapse
levels.author: TeamUprising
levels.desc: A beginner extreme with fast-paced flowy and learny gameplay by TeamUprising that uses a mix of all gamemodes. The difficulty of the gameplay increases near the end. levels.name: eclipse

levels.name: EdenCity
levels.author: NateFH

levels.name: UNG
levels.author: An Gyung
levels.desc: The hardest level in the An Gyung trilogy. It is mostly fast-paced with a slower predrop. The beginning is considered the hardest part, containing many awkward chokepoints.

levels.name: Supernova

levels.name: verisimilitude
levels.author: whlt
